guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 所有複雜的高中長難句，本質上都是五大句型的延伸與擴充。掌握動詞的及物 (transitive) 與不及物 (intransitive) 特性，就能一眼看穿長句的主幹核心。

tips.title: 五大句型結構矩陣 (The Five Sentence Structures)
tips.formula: S+Vi | S+V+SC | S+Vt+O | S+Vt+IO+DO | S+Vt+O+OC
tips.body: 1. 完全不及物 (S+V): Birds fly. 2. 不完全不及物 (S+V+SC): She looks happy. 3. 完全及物 (S+V+O): We love music. 4. 授與動詞 (S+V+IO+DO): He gave me a pen. 5. 不完全及物 (S+V+O+OC): They made him captain.
tips.example: The committee found the proposed technological solution highly viable.

tips.title: 補語 (Complement) 的本質：形容詞 vs. 副詞
tips.formula: S + make/find/keep + O + Adj (OC) [不可用副詞]
tips.body: 受詞補語用來補充說明受詞的性質或狀態，必須是形容詞或名詞，絕不可受中文翻譯影響而誤用副詞。
tips.example: The warm tea kept the weary hikers awake (not: *wearily awake).

traps.wrong: The teacher made the classroom quietly.
traps.correct: The teacher made the classroom quiet.
traps.reason: make + O + Adj.，classroom 的狀態是安靜的，補語應用形容詞 quiet，而非副詞 quietly。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: You look tired. Did the presentation go OK?
dialogue.zh: 你看起來很累，簡報還順利嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes. Our teacher gave us some helpful feedback.
dialogue.zh: 順利。老師給了我們一些有用的回饋。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Did it make you feel more confident?
dialogue.zh: 那有讓你更有信心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Definitely. We explained the idea clearly, and everyone understood.
dialogue.zh: 當然。我們把概念解釋清楚，大家都懂了。

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 非限定動詞 (Verbals) 是高中大考綜合測驗必考核心。動名詞 (V-ing) 帶有「已發生、習慣、回憶、經驗」之色彩；不定詞 (to V) 則指向「未發生、目標、企圖、未來」，掌握兩者時間箭頭方向即可秒殺試題。

tips.title: 雙向動詞的時間箭頭 (Temporal Distinction of Dual Verbs)
tips.formula: V + to V (指向未來未做) vs. V + V-ing (指向過去已做/正在做)
tips.body: remember / forget / regret + to V = 記得/忘記/遺憾去執行 (尚未發生)；remember / forget / regret + V-ing = 記得/忘記/後悔做過某事 (已發生)。
tips.example: Remember to lock the laboratory door tonight. vs. I distinctly remember locking it before leaving.

tips.title: 特殊介系詞 to 後接動名詞 (Prepositional 'to' + V-ing)
tips.formula: look forward to / be used to / devote oneself to / object to + V-ing
tips.body: 此處的 to 為介系詞而非不定詞標記，後方必須接動名詞或名詞。
tips.example: The scientist devoted his entire life to finding a cure for leukemia.

traps.wrong: I look forward to hear from you soon.
traps.correct: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
traps.reason: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面動詞必須使用動名詞 hearing。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Did you remember to send the application?
dialogue.zh: 你記得寄出申請了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I remember filling it out, but I don't remember clicking Send.
dialogue.zh: 我記得填好了，卻不記得有按寄出。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Let's check your sent folder before you submit it again.
dialogue.zh: 再送一次前，先看寄件備份吧。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Good idea. I need to stop rushing through online forms.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。我得改掉匆忙填表的習慣。

checklist: 我能清楚區分 remember/forget/regret 接 to V 與 V-ing 的時間與語義差異
我能熟練列舉 5 個接動名詞的介系詞 to 片語 (如 look forward to, object to 等)

extra.title: 不定詞與動名詞
extra.rule: to + 原形與 V-ing 可作名詞性成分，但動詞後接哪一種常由搭配決定。某些動詞兩者皆可但意思不同。

rows: Check the label before using it.
停止說話／停下原本的事來說話。

extra.trap: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞：I look forward to meeting you. 不寫 to meet。

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 高中學術英語與科普閱讀中，超過 35% 的動詞使用被動語態以營造客觀、科學的論述風格。本單元掌握無靈主詞與客觀報導被動句型 (It is believed that...)。

tips.title: 客觀報導句型雙重轉換 (Double Conversion of Impersonal Passives)
tips.formula: It is said/believed/reported that S + V  <=>  S + is said/believed/reported + to V / to have p.p.
tips.body: 當報導動作與原動作同時代，後接 to V；若原動作先於報導時間，後接 to have p.p. (完成不定詞)。
tips.example: It is believed that the pyramids were built over two decades. <=> The pyramids are believed to have been built over two decades.

tips.title: 無靈主詞 (Inanimate Subject) 的主動結構
tips.formula: Inanimate Noun + enable / force + O + to V；reveal + O 或 that 子句，不套用同一補語結構
tips.body: 英文偏好以無生命的抽象名詞 (如 research, urgency, technology) 當主詞，中文常需轉譯為條件或原因。
tips.example: A lack of sleep impairs cognitive function. (睡眠不足會損害認知功能)

traps.wrong: The ancient fortress is believed to build in the third century.
traps.correct: The ancient fortress is believed to have been built in the third century.
traps.reason: 堡壘是被建造的 (被動)，且發生在過去 (先發生)，需使用完成被動不定詞 to have been built。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: The notice says the lab is being renovated. Where will our class meet?
dialogue.zh: 公告說實驗室正在整修，我們要去哪裡上課？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: We've been moved to Room 305 for the next two weeks.
dialogue.zh: 未來兩週改到三〇五教室。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Will the equipment be moved there, too?
dialogue.zh: 設備也會搬過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Only the laptops. The larger machines will stay in storage.
dialogue.zh: 只有筆電，大型機器會留在儲藏室。

checklist: 我能熟練進行 It is reported that 與 S + is reported to V 雙向句型互換
我能準確運用 to have been p.p. 表達先於主句時態的被動狀態

extra.title: 被動語態與操作流程
extra.rule: 想聚焦承受動作的人事物時，用 be + 過去分詞。時態放在 be 上；需要時才加 by 說明執行者。

rows: The filter is cleaned every week.
The power must be turned off.

extra.trap: 只有能帶受詞的相關用法才可轉被動；happen 是不及物動詞，不寫 was happened。

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 名詞子句在句子中可作主詞、受詞、補語、同位語。學測與大考作文中，高分文章經常運用 that 名詞子句引導深刻論點，以及間接問句展示得體禮貌的提問技巧。

tips.title: 間接問句平鋪直敘語序 (Declarative Word Order of Indirect Questions)
tips.formula: Wh- / Whether / If + Subject + Verb [不可倒裝，無助動詞 do/does/did]
tips.body: 間接問句作為名詞子句嵌入主句時，語序必須恢復為「疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」，不可保留直接問句的倒裝結構。
tips.example: Direct: Where did they go? -> Indirect: I wonder where they went.

tips.title: 堅決建意命要動詞後 that 子句 (Subjunctive with Verbs of Demand/Suggestion)
tips.formula: S + demand/insist/suggest/order/require + that + S + (should) + V-原形
tips.body: 表要求或建議時，that 子句可用原形（美式常見）或 should + 原形；suggest 表「顯示」、insist 表「堅稱事實」時，須依語意選一般時態。
tips.example: The physician insisted that the patient (should) quit smoking immediately.

traps.wrong: He asked me where did I buy the textbook.
traps.correct: He asked me where I bought the textbook.
traps.reason: 間接問句為名詞子句，語序必須是「疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」，不可保留助動詞 did 倒裝。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Do you know when the interview starts?
dialogue.zh: 你知道面試什麼時候開始嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: The email says it starts at ten, but I'm not sure which room we're in.
dialogue.zh: 信上說十點，不過我不確定是哪間教室。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Could you ask whether we need to bring a printed resume?
dialogue.zh: 可以問問是否要帶紙本履歷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Sure. I'll also check who we should contact when we arrive.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我也會確認到了要找誰。

checklist: 我能在間接問句中正確使用平鋪直敘語序 (Wh- + S + V)
我能辨識並運用 6 個堅決建意命要動詞後 that 子句省略 should 的原形動詞考點

extra.title: 名詞子句與間接問句
extra.rule: 把一整個子句放進名詞的位置，可當主詞、受詞或補語。間接問句保留疑問詞，但子句採敘述句語序。

rows: I know that the test is difficult.
Do you know where the switch is?
不是 where is the switch。
what 包含「所說的事」，不另加先行詞。

extra.trap: 嵌入問句一般不使用疑問倒裝；可禮貌提問，但內部仍用敘述語序。

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 形容詞子句是英語提升資訊密度的核心引擎。學測閱讀與克漏字中，掌握先行詞 (antecedent) 與關係代名詞 (who, whom, which, that, whose) 的對應，以及「介系詞 + 關係代名詞」結構是衝刺頂標的基石。

tips.title: 關係代名詞格位判定原則 (Case Selection for Relative Pronouns)
tips.formula: 先行詞(人) + who(主格) / whom(受格) / whose(所有格) ; 先行詞(物) + which(主/受格) / whose(所有格)
tips.body: 先行詞在子句中作主詞用 who/which；作動詞或介系詞之受詞用 whom/which/that；作名詞所有格用 whose (+ 無冠詞名詞)。
tips.example: The researcher whose paper was cited over a thousand times received the Nobel Prize.

tips.title: 介系詞提前與關係代名詞 (Preposition + Relative Pronoun)
tips.formula: Prep + whom / Prep + which [絕不可用 that 或 who！]
tips.body: 當關係子句中動詞搭配的介系詞移至關係代名詞前方時，先行詞為人用 whom，先行詞為物用 which。介系詞後方絕對禁用 that！
tips.example: This is the ecological sanctuary in which hundreds of migratory birds nest (not: *in that).

traps.wrong: The platform on that we met was crowded.
traps.correct: The platform on which we met was crowded.
traps.reason: 介系詞後絕不可使用關係代名詞 that，指物時必須用 which。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Who's the student who designed this poster?
dialogue.zh: 設計這張海報的學生是誰？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: That's Nina. She's the one who runs the art club.
dialogue.zh: 是 Nina，她就是負責美術社的人。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I like the colors that she chose.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡她選的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Me too. The message is easy to read from across the room.
dialogue.zh: 我也是。從教室另一端也能輕鬆讀到標語。

checklist: 我能準確判斷關係代名詞主格、受格、所有格 (whose)
我能熟練掌握「介系詞 + whom / which」之大考必考規則

extra.title: 關係子句：先找缺口，再選代名詞
extra.rule: 關係子句修飾名詞。先把子句還原成獨立句，再找缺少的成分。who 常指人、which 指事物；限定用法中的 that 可指人或事物。當關係代名詞在限定子句中作受詞時可以省略。逗號後的非限定子句作補充說明，絕不用 that，且關係代名詞不可省略。
pairs: The girl who won the race is my sister.
who 是 won 的主詞，不可省略。
The book (that) I bought is useful.
I bought the book：缺受詞，限定子句的關係代名詞可以省略。
My bike, which is red, is outside.
逗號後補充資訊的非限定子句用 which，不用 that，也不可省略。
extra.trap: 錯：The book that I bought it is useful. → 刪除 it；that 已代表 bought 的受詞。The city which I visited 用 which，因 visited 缺受詞。此處非限定關係子句不用 that；不能推廣成所有逗號後都禁止 that。
extra.model: The teacher who teaches English is kind. The teacher I met yesterday is kind. 第二句可加入 whom / who / that；第一句不能省略 who。

extra.title: 關係子句：把描述接到名詞後
extra.rule: 關係子句修飾前面的名詞。先找先行詞，再判斷它在子句裡是主詞、受詞或所有關係。

rows: The student who fixed it is here.
who 是 fixed 的主詞。
The tool that I bought is useful.
that 作 bought 的受詞，限定用法可省略。
The student whose project won is happy.
My bike, which is old, still works.
逗號隔開補充資訊；這裡不用 that。

extra.trap: 主詞關係代名詞不能直接省掉；The student who fixed it，不寫 The student fixed it is here。

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 副詞子句如同文章的導航路標。掌握表時間 (as soon as, while)、因果 (since, because)、條件 (as long as, provided that)、讓步 (although, even though) 的連接詞，是寫作時避免串句 (run-on sentences) 的關鍵。

tips.title: 條件與時間副詞子句時態陷阱 (Present Tense for Future in Adverbial Clauses)
tips.formula: If / When / As soon as / Unless + S + V-現在式, S + will + V-原形
tips.body: 表一般未來時間或條件時，子句通常用現在式，也可用現在完成式表先完成；主句亦可用情態助動詞或祈使句。
tips.example: As soon as the experiment yields definitive results tomorrow, the team will submit the paper.

tips.title: 連接詞 (Conjunction) vs. 介系詞 (Preposition) vs. 轉折副詞 (Transition)
tips.formula: Although + S + V (從屬連接詞) vs. Despite + N/V-ing (介系詞) vs. However, S + V (轉折副詞)
tips.body: 三者語意相近但句構截然不同：Although 接完整子句；Despite 接名詞片語；However 是副詞，後面須加逗號且不可連接兩子句。
tips.example: Although it rained heavily, they went hiking. <=> Despite the heavy rain, they went hiking. <=> It rained heavily; however, they went hiking.

traps.wrong: Although the budget was limited, but the team succeeded.
traps.correct: Although the budget was limited, the team succeeded.
traps.reason: 英文中 Although (從屬連接詞) 與 but (對等連接詞) 不可同時出現在同一個句子中。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Why are we starting the cleanup so early?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼淨灘這麼早就開始？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Because it gets hot by noon. We'll finish before the sun is too strong.
dialogue.zh: 因為中午會很熱，我們要在陽光太強前結束。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Although I'm not a morning person, I'll be there.
dialogue.zh: 雖然我不太習慣早起，還是會去。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Thanks. Bring a reusable bottle so that you can refill it at the station.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。帶可重複使用的水瓶，就能在補給站裝水。

checklist: 我能熟練區分 Although (連接詞)、Despite (介系詞) 與 However (副詞) 的語法結構
我能在時間與條件副詞子句中正確使用「現在式代替未來式」

extra.title: 副詞子句與連接詞
extra.rule: 用連接詞呈現時間、原因、讓步或結果。先判斷後方是完整子句，還是名詞片語。
flow: 子句 or 名詞片語？

rows: It rained, so we stayed home.
therefore 是連接副詞，注意句號／分號。

extra.trap: although 與 but 不需在同一組主從結構重複；because 和 so 也不要機械雙用。

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 逗號在英文關係子句中具有生死攸關的語義區隔。限定用法縮小範圍；非限定用法 (加逗號) 提供額外補充說明。非限定關係子句絕對不能使用 that！

tips.title: 非限定子句修飾整句或先行詞 (Comma + which / who)
tips.formula: S + V + O, which + V (which 代替前面整個句子或先行詞)
tips.body: 逗號後的 which 不僅可指代前面的名詞，更常指代前面整個句子所陳述的事實，which 指整件事時用單數；若指複數名詞，則須配合該名詞用複數。
tips.example: The factory reduced greenhouse emissions by 40%, which surprised regulatory authorities.

tips.title: 限定 vs. 非限定的語意對比 (Semantic Distinction)
tips.formula: He has two sons who are doctors (可能有其他兒子) vs. He has two sons, who are doctors (總共只有兩個兒子)
tips.body: 無逗號為限定修飾 (眾多中的一部分)；有逗號為補充說明 (等於全部)。
tips.example: Paris, which is the capital of France, attracts millions of tourists annually.

traps.wrong: He won the gold medal, that made his parents proud.
traps.correct: He won the gold medal, which made his parents proud.
traps.reason: 逗號後的非限定關係子句代指前面整件事實，必須使用 which，絕對不可使用 that。

words.zh: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
績效評估評價考評報告
條理連貫的、前後一致的
貌似合理的、合乎情理的
可信賴的;可靠的;確實的
具多重解釋的、含混不清的

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Do you mean your cousin who lives in Seattle?
dialogue.zh: 你是說住在西雅圖的那位表親嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes. I have three cousins, so that detail helps identify her.
dialogue.zh: 對。我有三個表親，那個細節能說清楚是哪一位。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: My cousin, who lives in Boston, is visiting next month.
dialogue.zh: 我的表姊住在波士頓，下個月要來。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: So you're adding a detail about the cousin we already know.
dialogue.zh: 所以你是在補充我們已經知道的那位表姊的資訊。

checklist: 我能清楚分辨有無逗號對關係子句語意的決定性影響
我能熟練運用「, which」代指前面整個事件並接單數動詞

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 學測指考常考的高階關係代名詞：what (= the thing which)、whoever (= anyone who)、whichever，以及準關係代名詞 as, than, but。掌握本單元是長篇閱讀突破 80 分的關鍵鑰匙。

tips.title: 複合關係代名詞 what 的本質 (The Anatomy of 'What')
tips.formula: what + 缺主詞或受詞之不完整子句 = the thing(s) which / that
tips.body: what 本身兼具「先行詞 + 關係代名詞」雙重身分，因此前面絕對不可再有先行詞！
tips.example: What surprised everyone was her calm demeanor under pressure.

tips.title: 準關係代名詞 as 的常規句型 (Quasi-Relative 'As')
tips.formula: as is known to all / as was expected / such ... as ...
tips.body: as 可作準關係代名詞引導子句，常置於句首代指後面的整句話，意為「正如...所...」。
tips.example: As is widely acknowledged, physical exercise enhances mental health.

traps.wrong: I cannot understand the reason what made her quit.
traps.correct: I cannot understand the reason why/that made her quit.
traps.reason: what 前面不可有先行詞 the reason；此處先行詞已存在，應用 why 或 which/that。

words.zh: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
績效評估評價考評報告
條理連貫的、前後一致的
貌似合理的、合乎情理的
可信賴的;可靠的;確實的
具多重解釋的、含混不清的

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Who should we give the extra tickets to?
dialogue.zh: 多出來的票要給誰？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Whoever signs up first can have them.
dialogue.zh: 先報名的人就可以拿。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: And what should people bring to the workshop?
dialogue.zh: 那參加工作坊的人要帶什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: They can bring whatever they need for their own project.
dialogue.zh: 帶自己作品需要的東西就可以。

checklist: 我能準確區分 what (自帶先行詞) 與 that / which (前有先行詞) 的語法條件
我能掌握 as is expected 等準關係代名詞片語之用法

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 學測綜合測驗與篇章結構題型的核心考點就是篇章標記 (Discourse Markers)。掌握因果 (consequently, therefore)、轉折 (on the other hand, in contrast)、遞進 (moreover, furthermore)、舉例 (for instance, to illustrate) 的轉折副詞，是打通高二長文脈絡的命脈。

tips.title: 篇章轉折副詞標點規範 (Punctuation of Transition Adverbs)
tips.formula: Sentence 1; therefore, Sentence 2.  OR  Sentence 1. In addition, Sentence 2.
tips.body: 連接副詞不能只靠單一逗號連接兩個獨立子句。位於句首時常加逗號，也可放在句中：I therefore agree.，標點依位置判斷。
tips.example: The cost of lithium batteries has plummeted; consequently, electric vehicle adoption has surged.

tips.title: 四大核心邏輯語義家族 (Four Major Logical Families)
tips.formula: Contrast (轉折) | Additive (遞進) | Causal (因果) | Exemplification (舉例)
tips.body: 1. 轉折: nevertheless, however, conversely 2. 遞進: furthermore, moreover, additionally 3. 因果: thus, hence, accordingly 4. 舉例: specifically, notably.
tips.example: Renewable energy produces minimal emissions. Furthermore, operational costs decline over time.

traps.wrong: He missed the train, therefore he arrived late.
traps.correct: He missed the train; therefore, he arrived late.
traps.reason: therefore 是副詞而非連接詞，不可只用一個逗號連接兩句，前面必須用分號或句號。

words.zh: 凝聚力內聚性緊密黏合

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: This paragraph starts with however. What's the contrast?
dialogue.zh: 這段以 however 開頭，轉折在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: The first paragraph lists the benefits. This one explains the costs.
dialogue.zh: 第一段列出好處，這段說明成本。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Then for example introduces the parking fees?
dialogue.zh: 接著 for example 是引出停車費的例子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Exactly. Each connector tells us how the next idea relates to the last one.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。每個連接語都說明新舊想法如何相關。

checklist: 我能避免轉折副詞造成的逗號串句 (Comma Splice) 錯誤
我能在學測綜合測驗與篇章題中精準配對因果、轉折與遞進標記

extra.title: 段落連貫：連接語與代名詞要接得上
extra.rule: 篇章連貫（Cohesion 與 Coherence）是大考與學術寫作的靈魂。連接詞與轉折語表達句與句之間的邏輯關係。關鍵語法分界：從屬/對等連接詞（如 but, although, because, so）能直接連接兩個子句；而連接副詞（Conjunctive Adverbs，如 however, therefore, moreover, nevertheless, furthermore）本質上是副詞，不能只用一個逗號連接兩句（此為典型 Comma Splice 錯誤），必須使用「句號 + However,」或「分號 ; however,」。此外，指示詞（this, these）、such + 名詞及代名詞（it, they）必須在上下文中有明確、無歧義的指涉對象。
pairs: The app is convenient. However, it requires an internet connection.
便利是優點，需連網是限制；however 標示轉折，前後以句號與逗號隔開；it 指 app。
The road was flooded. Therefore, the school bus took another route.
淹水造成改道；therefore 標示因果結果。
Students compared two reports. This comparison helped them identify conflicting claims.
This comparison 接回比較兩份報告這個動作；them 指代前述的 students。
extra.trap: 常見考場陷阱 ➔ 錯：It rained, however we went out.（Comma Splice 標點錯誤）➔ 正確：It rained. However, we went out. 或 It rained, but we went out. 另外：不要用 although 與 but 重複連接同一組主從子句（受中文「雖然……但是……」影響之典型中式英文）。
extra.model: Flashcards help me recall words. However, isolated words do not show how to use them. I therefore add an example sentence to each card. 檢查 however 前後有對比，them 指 words，最後一句回應限制。

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 108 課綱學測全新命題亮點：混合題型 (Hybrid Questions) 與圖表多文本題。結合柱狀圖、圓餅圖、趨勢線與專題報導，要求考生具備跨文本檢索、對照、歸納與簡答書寫的能力。

tips.title: 圖表數據描述的核心動詞與趨勢用語 (Vocabulary for Data Description)
tips.formula: surge / skyrocket (急升) | plunge / plummet (急跌) | fluctuate (波動) | plateau (持平)
tips.body: 描述數據變化時，善用精準動詞與副詞：grow steadily, decline marginally, peak at, drop to an all-time low.
tips.example: Renewable generation peaked in July, whereas coal dependency declined precipitously.

tips.title: 雙文本觀點比對法則 (Cross-Text Comparative Protocol)
tips.formula: Text A (客觀數據/圖表) + Text B (個人投書/社論) -> 尋找矛盾點與支持證據
tips.body: 混合題常要求考生從文章中挑選一個字詞填空，或以簡答句說明 Text A 數據如何支持或反駁 Text B 的觀點。
tips.example: According to Figure 1, the data directly contradicts the author's claim in paragraph 2.

traps.wrong: 填空題自己任意把文章中的名詞改寫成動詞形式。
traps.correct: 嚴格遵守題目指示，若註明 'from the passage' 必須原形/原詞摘錄。
traps.reason: 學測混合題有嚴格評分規準，規定自文章摘錄者任意改寫將不予給分。

words.zh: 經銷通路物流配銷分配

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: This graph shows longer screen time and lower test scores. Does one cause the other?
dialogue.zh: 這張圖顯示螢幕時間越長，成績越低。一個會造成另一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Not necessarily. The graph only shows a relationship.
dialogue.zh: 不一定。圖表只顯示關聯。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: The second article mentions sleep and study habits, too.
dialogue.zh: 第二篇文章還提到睡眠和讀書習慣。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Right. Those could affect both variables. We need more evidence.
dialogue.zh: 對。那些可能同時影響兩個變項，我們需要更多證據。

checklist: 我能讀懂圖表 X 軸、Y 軸、百分比並與英文文本資訊整合
我能正確回答學測混合題的文意定位與摘詞填空題目

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 學測長篇與英檢中高級寫作極度著重批判思考的謹慎度 (Hedging)。情態助動詞對現在與過去的推測 (must have, can't have, should have) 是高中階段最具鑑別度的語法之一。

tips.title: 對過去事件的推測矩陣 (Modal Deduction about Past Events)
tips.formula: must have p.p. (必定做過) | can't/couldn't have p.p. (不可能做過) | may/might have p.p. (可能做過)
tips.body: 情態助動詞後加 have + p.p. 表示對「過去事實」的推測或判斷。
tips.example: The streets are soaking wet; it must have rained cats and dogs last night.

tips.title: should have p.p. 的遺憾與責備 (Counterfactual Regret)
tips.formula: should have p.p. (本來應該做卻沒做) vs. shouldn't have p.p. (本來不該做卻做了)
tips.body: 表達與過去事實相反的批評或懊悔，為假設語氣的縮影。
tips.example: You should have double-checked the flight departure gate before sitting down.

traps.wrong: He didn't study, so he must fail the exam yesterday.
traps.correct: He didn't study, so he must have failed the exam yesterday.
traps.reason: yesterday 是過去時間，對過去事情的推測必須使用 must have + p.p.，而非 must + 原形。

words.zh: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
績效評估評價考評報告
條理連貫的、前後一致的
貌似合理的、合乎情理的
可信賴的;可靠的;確實的
具多重解釋的、含混不清的

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: The classroom is empty. They must have canceled the meeting.
dialogue.zh: 教室空空的，他們一定取消會議了。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: They might have moved it. There's a note on the door.
dialogue.zh: 也可能是換地方了，門上有張字條。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: You're right. It says Room 402.
dialogue.zh: 你說得對，上面寫四〇二教室。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: So the meeting can't be here. Let's go upstairs.
dialogue.zh: 所以會議不在這裡，我們上樓吧。

checklist: 我能精確區分 must have p.p. (必定做過) 與 should have p.p. (本該做卻沒做)
我能在批判性閱讀中敏銳識別作者推測語氣的強弱程度

extra.title: 助動詞：能力、義務與推測
extra.rule: can、must、should、may 等情態助動詞後接原形動詞，藉語氣表達能力、建議、義務或可能性。

rows: can 後不加 to 或 s。
You must not touch the wire.
You do not have to come early.

extra.trap: must 的否定 must not 是禁止；不必用 do not have to 或 need not。

guide.goal: 大考中心大學學測英文科命題規準：進階五大句型、動名詞語意區分、客觀被動語態、名詞副詞子句與 4500 詞彙。
guide.motivation: 高一學習的集大成驗收。將五大句型、非限定動詞、被動語態、各類從屬子句、篇章標記與多文本整合，透過標準大考全真混合題架構進行實戰檢驗，為高二分詞與假設語氣打下磐石基礎。

tips.title: 長篇混合題五步解題心法 (GSAT 5-Step Hybrid Mastery)
tips.formula: 1. 審視題幹關鍵詞 -> 2. 略讀文章抓主旨 -> 3. 掃讀定位精準句 -> 4. 檢驗句構文法格位 -> 5. 謄寫抄錄無失誤
tips.body: 面對大考長達 400-500 字的高難度文本，不可從頭死記。先看問題要求找人名、地名、年份或名詞，直擊原文段落。
tips.example: Step 1 marks the question keyword 'thermal insulation'; Step 3 locates paragraph 4 line 3.

traps.wrong: 長難句讀到後面就忘記前面主詞是單數還是複數。
traps.correct: 用鉛筆圈出核心主詞，排除所有夾在主詞與動詞間的修飾語。
traps.reason: 大考最常見的陷阱就是主詞與動詞之間插入長達三行的關係子句，考生常誤將子句受詞當成主詞選錯動詞單複數。

words.zh: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
績效評估評價考評報告
條理連貫的、前後一致的
貌似合理的、合乎情理的
可信賴的;可靠的;確實的
具多重解釋的、含混不清的

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Which sentence best summarizes the article?
dialogue.zh: 哪一句最能概括這篇文章？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I'd choose B. It includes both the problem and the proposed solution.
dialogue.zh: 我選 B，它包含問題和提出的解法。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: What makes C less suitable?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼 C 比較不適合？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: It only describes one example. The whole article covers a broader issue.
dialogue.zh: 它只描述一個例子，整篇文章討論的議題更廣。

checklist: 我能融會貫通高一全冊五大句型、子句與篇章結構
我具備自信挑戰學測全真混合題與圖表綜合分析能力

extra.title: 跨文化比較與國際禮儀：說明差異與原因
extra.rule: 比較文化時，從「描述 → 比較 → 解釋原因 → 反思」四層次說明：描述具體行為（In Japan, people often remove their shoes indoors.）、比較（Similarly / In contrast）、解釋原因（This may be because… / This reflects…）、反思自身（This made me realize…）。避免以單一經驗概括整個國家（stereotype），改用 many、often、some。國際禮儀包含守時、致謝信、名片雙手遞接、用餐禮節與稱謂（Dr.、Prof.、Ms.），不同場合正式程度也不同。臺灣社會本身就有原住民族、新住民與不同族群的文化，用同樣的尊重態度認識身邊的多元文化，是文化素養的起點。
pairs: In contrast to Taiwan, tipping is expected in many U.S. restaurants.
用 In contrast to 比較差異。
This may be because servers’ wages depend partly on tips.
Many, though not all, Germans value punctuality highly.
用 many、though not all 避免刻板印象。
extra.trap: 常見錯誤：All Americans are loud.（以偏概全）→ Some people I met spoke more loudly than I expected.；只描述差異卻不探討原因，論述會流於表面。
extra.model: In Taiwan, people often refuse a gift once or twice before accepting it, while in the U.S. people usually accept and open it immediately. This may be because modesty is highly valued in Taiwanese culture, whereas Americans show appreciation by reacting right away. Neither way is better; understanding the reason helps me avoid misunderstandings. 檢查：有比較、原因、反思且無刻板印象嗎？

g10-s1-u1.w1m.why: complement /ˈkɑːmplɪmənt/：補語；補充物。例：In this sentence, the adjective acts as an object complement.

g10-s1-u1.w3m.why: viable /ˈvaɪəbl/：切實可行的。例：Scientists consider solar-powered desalination a viable alternative.

g10-s1-u1.w3l.why: 你聽到的是 viable（切實可行的）。

g10-s1-u1.w3c.prompt: 填入缺少的字（提示：切實可行的）
g10-s1-u1.w3c.text: Scientists consider solar-powered desalination a _____ alternative.
g10-s1-u1.w3c.audioAfter: Scientists consider solar-powered desalination a viable alternative.
g10-s1-u1.w3c.why: 完整句子：Scientists consider solar-powered desalination a viable alternative.

g10-s1-u1.t1l.prompt: 聽一聽，這句話是什麼意思？
g10-s1-u1.t1l.audio: You look tired. Did the presentation go OK?
g10-s1-u1.t1l.answer: 你看起來很累，簡報還順利嗎？
options: 你看起來很累，簡報還順利嗎？

g10-s1-u1.tip1.title: 五大句型結構矩陣 (The Five Sentence Structures)
g10-s1-u1.tip1.body: 1. 完全不及物 (S+V): Birds fly. 2. 不完全不及物 (S+V+SC): She looks happy. 3. 完全及物 (S+V+O): We love music. 4. 授與動詞 (S+V+IO+DO): He gave me a pen. 5. 不完全及物 (S+V+O+OC): They made him captain.
g10-s1-u1.tip1.example: The committee found the proposed technological solution highly viable.

g10-s1-u1.x1.prompt: In “They made Amy captain,” what is “captain”?
g10-s1-u1.x1.why: Amy 是受詞，captain 補充說明 Amy 的身分，是受詞補語。

g10-s1-u1.tip2.title: 補語 (Complement) 的本質：形容詞 vs. 副詞
g10-s1-u1.tip2.formula: S + make/find/keep + O + Adj (OC) [不可用副詞]
g10-s1-u1.tip2.body: 受詞補語用來補充說明受詞的性質或狀態，必須是形容詞或名詞，絕不可受中文翻譯影響而誤用副詞。
g10-s1-u1.tip2.example: The warm tea kept the weary hikers awake (not: *wearily awake).

g10-s1-u1.x2.hint: S + make/find/keep + O + Adj (OC) [不可用副詞]
g10-s1-u1.x2.why: make + 受詞 + 形容詞補語；happy 描述 us 的狀態，不是以副詞修飾 made。

g10-s1-u1.q1.prompt: The committee considers the newly formulated environmental policy ________ for urban resilience.
g10-s1-u1.q1.hint: consider + O + OC，受詞補語需要形容詞。 中文常翻成『認為...是必要的』，但英語補語不可填副詞 essentially。
g10-s1-u1.q1.why: consider + O + Adj.，形容詞 essential 作受詞補語。

wrong.essentially: essentially 是副詞，consider 受詞後要接形容詞作補語，不能用副詞。
wrong.essentialness: essentialness 是名詞，consider + O 之後要接形容詞，不接名詞。
wrong.to essentially: to essentially 不是形容詞補語，consider 受詞後不接 to 加副詞。

g10-s1-u2.tip1.title: 雙向動詞的時間箭頭 (Temporal Distinction of Dual Verbs)
g10-s1-u2.tip1.formula: V + to V (指向未來未做) vs. V + V-ing (指向過去已做/正在做)
g10-s1-u2.tip1.body: remember / forget / regret + to V = 記得/忘記/遺憾去執行 (尚未發生)；remember / forget / regret + V-ing = 記得/忘記/後悔做過某事 (已發生)。
g10-s1-u2.tip1.example: Remember to lock the laboratory door tonight. vs. I distinctly remember locking it before leaving.

g10-s1-u2.x1.prompt: I clearly remember ___ the lab door, so the key must be somewhere else. Please remember ___ it again tonight.
g10-s1-u2.x1.hint: V + to V (指向未來未做) vs. V + V-ing (指向過去已做/正在做)
g10-s1-u2.x1.why: remember V-ing＝記得做過（已發生）；remember to V＝記得要去做（尚未發生）。第一句回想已經鎖過門，第二句提醒今晚要鎖。

wrong.to lock; locking: 回想過去已鎖過門要用 locking，這個選項前後順序顛倒了。
wrong.locking; locking: 第二句是提醒今晚去鎖門，還沒發生，要用 to lock。
wrong.to lock; to lock: 第一句是回想已鎖過門，要用 locking，不是 to lock。

g10-s1-u2.tip2.title: 特殊介系詞 to 後接動名詞 (Prepositional 'to' + V-ing)
g10-s1-u2.tip2.formula: look forward to / be used to / devote oneself to / object to + V-ing
g10-s1-u2.tip2.body: 此處的 to 為介系詞而非不定詞標記，後方必須接動名詞或名詞。
g10-s1-u2.tip2.example: The scientist devoted his entire life to finding a cure for leukemia.

g10-s1-u2.x2.prompt: Our international science seminar will officially commence ___ 9:00 a.m. ___ Monday morning ___ early October.
g10-s1-u2.x2.hint: 時間介系詞依範圍大小選擇：時刻、某一天（含某天的早上）、月份各用不同的介系詞。
g10-s1-u2.x2.why: 【考點解構】套用倒金字塔法則：特定時間點 9:00 a.m. 用 at；特定某天的早晨 (Monday morning) 用 on；月份十月 (October) 用 in，因此唯一正確搭配為 at; on; in。

wrong.in; at; on: 9:00 a.m. 是時間點要用 at，不是 in；順序全部錯。
wrong.on; in; at: 9:00 a.m. 要用 at，月份 October 要用 in，這個選項全部錯位。
wrong.at; in; on: Monday morning 要用 on，early October 要用 in，後兩個順序顛倒。

g10-s1-u2.q1.prompt: All the members of the expedition are looking forward to ________ the summit at sunrise.
g10-s1-u2.q1.hint: look forward to 中的 to 是介系詞。 介系詞後面接名詞或動名詞 V-ing。
g10-s1-u2.q1.why: look forward to + V-ing 為固定介系詞搭配，表示期待。

wrong.reach: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing，不能用原形。
wrong.reached: reached 是過去式或過去分詞，look forward to 後面要接 V-ing。
wrong.have reached: have reached 是完成式，look forward to 後面要接 V-ing。

g10-s1-u2.trap1.answer: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
options: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
I look forward to hear from you soon.
g10-s1-u2.trap1.why: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面動詞必須使用動名詞 hearing。

g10-s1-u2.r1.passage: Psychologists distinguish between striving to achieve goals and maintaining daily routines. When people attempt to establish a new habit, they often struggle with procrastination. Experts suggest breaking big challenges into small tasks. Instead of planning to run ten miles every weekend, committed individuals begin by walking fifteen minutes daily. After people become accustomed to exercising regularly, the habit continues almost automatically, without much mental effort.
g10-s1-u2.r1.passageTitle: The Psychology of Habit Formation (習慣建立的心理學機制)
g10-s1-u2.r1.prompt: Why does 'accustomed to' take 'exercising' instead of 'exercise'?
g10-s1-u2.r1.answer: Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.
options: Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.
Because 'recommend that' requires the subjunctive mood (should + base form).
The entire preceding fact that mold had dissolved surrounding staphylococcus colonies.
g10-s1-u2.r1.hint: 非限定動詞辨識：圈出文章中的 to V 與 V-ing，判斷是表目的還是表既定習慣。
g10-s1-u2.r1.why: 文章依據：Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.

wrong.Because 'recommend that' requires the su: 這是另一題 recommend that 的解釋，與 accustomed to 後接動名詞無關。
wrong.The entire preceding fact that mold had: 這句與文章內容無關，文章談習慣養成，沒有提到黴菌。

gr.infinitives.hint: to + 原形與 V-ing 可作名詞性成分，但動詞後接哪一種常由搭配決定。某些動詞兩者皆可但意思不同。

wrong.check: finish 後面要接動名詞，原形 check 文法不對。
wrong.to check: finish 後面不接不定詞 to V，要接動名詞 checking。

g10-s1-u3.tip1.title: 客觀報導句型雙重轉換 (Double Conversion of Impersonal Passives)
g10-s1-u3.tip1.formula: It is said/believed/reported that S + V  <=>  S + is said/believed/reported + to V / to have p.p.
g10-s1-u3.tip1.body: 當報導動作與原動作同時代，後接 to V；若原動作先於報導時間，後接 to have p.p. (完成不定詞)。
g10-s1-u3.tip1.example: It is believed that the pyramids were built over two decades. <=> The pyramids are believed to have been built over two decades.

g10-s1-u3.x1.prompt: It is believed that the old bridge was built in the 12th century. → The old bridge is believed ___ in the 12th century.
g10-s1-u3.x1.hint: It is said/believed/reported that S + V <=> S + is said/believed/reported + to V / to have p.p.
g10-s1-u3.x1.why: 建造（過去）早於「被相信」（現在），而且橋是被建造的，所以用完成式被動不定詞 to have been built。

wrong.to build: 橋是被建造的，要用被動，to build 是主動且沒有表達過去先發生。
wrong.to be built: to be built 是一般被動，沒有表達建造早於被相信的先後。
wrong.having built: having built 是主動完成分詞，橋是被建造的，且 believed 後不接分詞。

g10-s1-u3.tip2.title: 無靈主詞 (Inanimate Subject) 的主動結構
g10-s1-u3.tip2.formula: Inanimate Noun + enable / force + O + to V；reveal + O 或 that 子句，不套用同一補語結構
g10-s1-u3.tip2.body: 英文偏好以無生命的抽象名詞 (如 research, urgency, technology) 當主詞，中文常需轉譯為條件或原因。
g10-s1-u3.tip2.example: A lack of sleep impairs cognitive function. (睡眠不足會損害認知功能)

g10-s1-u3.x2.prompt: Which sentence uses an inanimate subject naturally?
g10-s1-u3.x2.answer: The heavy rain delayed the train.
options: The heavy rain delayed the train.
The train was delay by rain.
g10-s1-u3.x2.hint: Inanimate Noun + enable / force + O + to V；reveal + O 或 that 子句，不套用同一補語結構
g10-s1-u3.x2.why: rain 是無生命主詞，delayed 是限定動詞，句子自然。The train was delay by rain 缺過去分詞（應為 was delayed）；The rain delaying the train 缺限定動詞。

被動語態要用過去分詞 delayed，delay 是原形，形式錯誤。
句中缺限定動詞，delaying 是分詞，不能單獨當句子的動詞。

g10-s1-u3.q1.prompt: The manuscript, discovered in the monastery archives, is believed ________ by a fourteenth-century monk.
g10-s1-u3.q1.hint: manuscript（手稿）是「寫」還是「被寫」？書寫發生的時間比「被認為」早還是同時？
g10-s1-u3.q1.why: 手稿在過去被寫成，故選用完成被動不定詞 to have been written。

wrong.to write: 手稿是被寫出來的，要用被動，to write 是主動且沒有完成式。
wrong.to be written: to be written 是一般被動，沒有表達寫作早於被相信的先後。
wrong.to have written: to have written 是主動完成式，手稿不會自己寫字，要用被動。

g10-s1-u3.trap1.answer: The ancient fortress is believed to have been built in the third century.
options: The ancient fortress is believed to have been built in the third century.
The ancient fortress is believed to build in the third century.
g10-s1-u3.trap1.why: 堡壘是被建造的 (被動)，且發生在過去 (先發生)，需使用完成被動不定詞 to have been built。

wrong.The ancient fortress is believed to buil: 堡壘是被建造的，要用被動，且發生在過去，需用 to have been built。

gr.passive.hint: 想聚焦承受動作的人事物時，用 be + 過去分詞。時態放在 be 上；需要時才加 by 說明執行者。

wrong.turned off: must 後面要接原形，turned off 缺 be，被動結構不完整。

d.diag-0931.prompt: The suspect is alleged ___ the corporate database from an offshore server.
d.diag-0931.hint: 題意：該嫌疑犯被指控曾從境外伺服器入侵攻破了企業資料庫。
d.diag-0931.why: be alleged to have + p.p. 表示「據指控先前曾做過某事」（完成不定詞表示動作發生在被指控之前）。 據稱曾做過選 to have breached。
d.diag-0931.topic: 限制與被動語態複合句型

wrong.breached: is alleged 後面要接不定詞，breached 是過去式，不能直接接。
wrong.breaching: is alleged 後不接 V-ing，要接不定詞，且需表示先前做過。
wrong.to breach: to breach 沒有表達入侵發生在被指控之前，要用完成式 to have breached。

d.diag-0932.prompt: The historic temple is widely deemed ___ the crown jewel of ancient Taiwanese architecture.
d.diag-0932.hint: 題意：這座歷史名廟被廣泛視為台灣古代建築的皇冠明珠瑰寶。
d.diag-0932.why: be deemed to be + 名詞/形容詞，意為「被視為、被認為是」。 被視為選 to be。
d.diag-0932.topic: 限制與被動語態複合句型

wrong.being: deemed 後面接不定詞 to be，不接 being。
wrong.been: been 是過去分詞，deemed 後面要接 to be，不能只接 been。
wrong.was: was 是限定動詞，is deemed 已有動詞，不能再接 was。

d.diag-0933.prompt: The ancient Egyptian pharaoh was believed ___ magnificent golden tombs.
d.diag-0933.hint: 題意：那位古埃及法老被深信生前曾下令建造了壯麗的黃金陵寢。
d.diag-0933.why: was believed to have + p.p. 表過去被相信曾下令建造。 完成不定詞選 to have commissioned。

g10-s1-u4.tip1.title: 間接問句平鋪直敘語序 (Declarative Word Order of Indirect Questions)
g10-s1-u4.tip1.formula: Wh- / Whether / If + Subject + Verb [不可倒裝，無助動詞 do/does/did]
g10-s1-u4.tip1.body: 間接問句作為名詞子句嵌入主句時，語序必須恢復為「疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」，不可保留直接問句的倒裝結構。
g10-s1-u4.tip1.example: Direct: Where did they go? -> Indirect: I wonder where they went.

g10-s1-u4.tip2.title: 堅決建意命要動詞後 that 子句 (Subjunctive with Verbs of Demand/Suggestion)
g10-s1-u4.tip2.formula: S + demand/insist/suggest/order/require + that + S + (should) + V-原形
g10-s1-u4.tip2.body: 表要求或建議時，that 子句可用原形（美式常見）或 should + 原形；suggest 表「顯示」、insist 表「堅稱事實」時，須依語意選一般時態。
g10-s1-u4.tip2.example: The physician insisted that the patient (should) quit smoking immediately.

g10-s1-u4.x2.prompt: The doctor insisted that the patient ___ smoking immediately.
g10-s1-u4.x2.hint: S + demand/insist/suggest/order/require + that + S + (should) + V-原形
g10-s1-u4.x2.why: insist 表「堅持要求」時，that 子句用 (should) + 原形：(should) quit。若 insist 是「堅稱某事屬實」，才依事實使用一般時態。

wrong.quits: insist 表堅持要求時，that 子句用原形，quits 加了 s 不合。
wrong.quitted: quitted 是過去式，堅持要求的 that 子句要用原形 quit。
wrong.will quit: will quit 是未來式，insist 要求的 that 子句要用原形，不用 will。

g10-s1-u4.q1.prompt: The laboratory safety inspector demanded that all hazardous chemicals ________ in fireproof cabinets immediately.

g10-s1-u4.q1.why: demand that + S + (should) + 原形動詞，化學物品需被存放，故省略 should 後保留原形 be stored。

wrong.stored: 「stored」的意思是「商店、店家」，放進這裡不符合句意或用法；正確答案是「be stored」。

g10-s1-u5.tip1.formula: 先行詞(人) + who(主格) / whom(受格) / whose(所有格) ; 先行詞(物) + which(主/受格) / whose(所有格)
g10-s1-u5.tip1.body: 先行詞在子句中作主詞用 who/which；作動詞或介系詞之受詞用 whom/which/that；作名詞所有格用 whose (+ 無冠詞名詞)。

g10-s1-u5.x1.why: 【考點解構】先行詞 The ancient manuscript 為無生命事物，且前後以逗號隔開為「非限定關係子句」；考場必背鐵律：that 絕不可用於逗號之後的非限定子句，故只能選 which。

wrong.that: 「that」的意思是「那;那個」；這裡要的是「which」（哪一個,哪一些;這個,這些）。

g10-s1-u5.tip2.title: 介系詞提前與關係代名詞 (Preposition + Relative Pronoun)
g10-s1-u5.tip2.formula: Prep + whom / Prep + which [絕不可用 that 或 who！]
g10-s1-u5.tip2.body: 當關係子句中動詞搭配的介系詞移至關係代名詞前方時，先行詞為人用 whom，先行詞為物用 which。介系詞後方絕對禁用 that！
g10-s1-u5.tip2.example: This is the ecological sanctuary in which hundreds of migratory birds nest (not: *in that).

g10-s1-u5.x2.prompt: Our international science seminar will officially commence ___ 9:00 a.m. ___ Monday morning ___ early October.
g10-s1-u5.x2.hint: 時間介系詞：時刻、某一天（含某天的早上）、月份，各用哪個介系詞？
g10-s1-u5.x2.why: 【考點解構】套用倒金字塔法則：特定時間點 9:00 a.m. 用 at；特定某天的早晨 (Monday morning) 用 on；月份十月 (October) 用 in，因此唯一正確搭配為 at; on; in。

wrong.in; at; on: 9:00 a.m. 是時間點要用 at，不是 in；順序全部錯。
wrong.on; in; at: 9:00 a.m. 要用 at，月份 October 要用 in，這個選項全部錯位。
wrong.at; in; on: Monday morning 要用 on，early October 要用 in，後兩個順序顛倒。

g10-s1-u5.q1.prompt: The symposium provided an inspiring platform on ________ leading climatologists discussed renewable energy strategies.
g10-s1-u5.q1.hint: 空格前有介系詞 on，想想哪些關係詞可以直接放在介系詞後面。
g10-s1-u5.q1.why: 介系詞 on 後接指稱物的關係代名詞 which (on which = where)。

wrong.that: 「that」的意思是「那;那個」；這裡要的是「which」（哪一個,哪一些;這個,這些）。

g10-s1-u5.trap1.answer: The platform on which we met was crowded.
options: The platform on which we met was crowded.
The platform on that we met was crowded.
g10-s1-u5.trap1.why: 介系詞後絕不可使用關係代名詞 that，指物時必須用 which。

介系詞後面不能直接接關係代名詞 that，指物時要用 on which。

g10-s1-u5.r1.passage: In 1960, Jane Goodall arrived at the Gombe Stream reserve in present-day Tanzania, an environment about which the scientific world knew very little. She observed primates whose intricate social hierarchies amazed ethologists. The breakthrough discovery that chimpanzees make and use tools, an ability with which humans previously credited only themselves, fundamentally revolutionized anthropology.
g10-s1-u5.r1.passageTitle: Jane Goodall and the Chimpanzees of Gombe (珍古德與岡貝黑猩猩研究)
g10-s1-u5.r1.prompt: Why is 'which' used in 'an environment about which' instead of 'that'?
g10-s1-u5.r1.answer: Because 'that' cannot follow a preposition directly in a relative clause.
options: Because 'that' cannot follow a preposition directly in a relative clause.
The metropolis is now believed to have supported more than one hundred thousand inhabitants.
Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.
g10-s1-u5.r1.hint: 關係子句定位：畫出先行詞與關係子句，辨識修飾關係與介系詞來源。
g10-s1-u5.r1.why: 文章依據：Because 'that' cannot follow a preposition directly in a relative clause.

wrong.The metropolis is now believed to have s: 這句與文章內容無關，文章談 Goodall 在 Gombe 的研究，沒有提到都市居民。
wrong.Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a: 這是另一題 accustomed to 的解釋，與關係代名詞 which 無關。

k.relative-clauses.tip.title: 關係子句：先找缺口，再選代名詞
k.relative-clauses.tip.formula: 分辨關係代名詞在子句中當主詞或受詞，掌握限定與非限定用法，避免重複代名詞。
k.relative-clauses.tip.body: 關係子句修飾名詞。先把子句還原成獨立句，再找缺少的成分。who 常指人、which 指事物；限定用法中的 that 可指人或事物。當關係代名詞在限定子句中作受詞時可以省略。逗號後的非限定子句作補充說明，絕不用 that，且關係代名詞不可省略。
k.relative-clauses.tip.example: The girl who won the race is my sister. / The book (that) I bought is useful.

k.relative-clauses.1.prompt: The student ___ helped me is Leo.
k.relative-clauses.1.why: 缺 helped 的主詞，用 who。whom 是受詞形式；where 表地點關係，不能當此處主詞。
k.relative-clauses.1.hint: 先把關係子句還原成獨立句，看缺的是主詞還是受詞；再看先行詞是人還是物。

options: The movie that I watched it was moving.
The movie I watched was moving.
The movie, that I watched, was moving.
k.relative-clauses.2.answer: The movie I watched was moving.
k.relative-clauses.2.why: 限定子句中 watched 的受詞代名詞可省略。第一句 it 重複；第三句非限定用法不能使用 that。
k.relative-clauses.2.hint: 先把關係子句還原成獨立句，檢查有沒有重複受詞，並注意逗號和 that 的搭配限制。

watched 的受詞已由關係代名詞 that 代替，再加 it 就重複了。
加逗號是非限定用法，非限定子句不能用 that。

gr.relative.prompt: The woman ___ teaches us is an engineer.
gr.relative.why: 先行詞是人，子句缺主詞，用 who。
gr.relative.hint: 關係子句修飾前面的名詞。先找先行詞，再判斷它在子句裡是主詞、受詞或所有關係。

g10-s1-u6.tip1.title: 條件與時間副詞子句時態陷阱 (Present Tense for Future in Adverbial Clauses)
g10-s1-u6.tip1.formula: If / When / As soon as / Unless + S + V-現在式, S + will + V-原形
g10-s1-u6.tip1.body: 表一般未來時間或條件時，子句通常用現在式，也可用現在完成式表先完成；主句亦可用情態助動詞或祈使句。
g10-s1-u6.tip1.example: As soon as the experiment yields definitive results tomorrow, the team will submit the paper.

g10-s1-u6.x1.prompt: I will call you when I ___ at the station.
g10-s1-u6.x1.hint: If / When / As soon as / Unless + S + V-現在式, S + will + V-原形
g10-s1-u6.x1.why: 表未來時間的 when 副詞子句通常用現在式 arrive；不是所有含 when 的句子都如此。

wrong.will arrive: 表未來時間的 when 子句不能用 will，要用現在式 arrive。
wrong.arrived: 過去式 arrived 指已發生的事，但句子說的是未來要打電話。

g10-s1-u6.tip2.title: 連接詞 (Conjunction) vs. 介系詞 (Preposition) vs. 轉折副詞 (Transition)
g10-s1-u6.tip2.formula: Although + S + V (從屬連接詞) vs. Despite + N/V-ing (介系詞) vs. However, S + V (轉折副詞)
g10-s1-u6.tip2.body: 三者語意相近但句構截然不同：Although 接完整子句；Despite 接名詞片語；However 是副詞，後面須加逗號且不可連接兩子句。

g10-s2-u7.tip1.title: 非限定子句修飾整句或先行詞 (Comma + which / who)
g10-s2-u7.tip1.formula: S + V + O, which + V (which 代替前面整個句子或先行詞)
g10-s2-u7.tip1.body: 逗號後的 which 不僅可指代前面的名詞，更常指代前面整個句子所陳述的事實，which 指整件事時用單數；若指複數名詞，則須配合該名詞用複數。
g10-s2-u7.tip1.example: The factory reduced greenhouse emissions by 40%, which surprised regulatory authorities.

g10-s2-u7.x1.prompt: The factory cut its emissions by 40 percent, ___ surprised many experts.

g10-s2-u7.x1.why: 逗號後補充說明前面整件事，用非限定的 which。that 不能用在逗號後的非限定子句；what 本身不接先行詞；用 it 會讓兩個子句沒有連接詞。

wrong.that: 逗號後的非限定子句不能用 that，要用 which。
wrong.what: what 本身含先行詞，不能用來補充說明前面整件事。
wrong.it: 用 it 會變成兩個子句直接相連，缺少連接詞。

g10-s2-u7.tip2.title: 限定 vs. 非限定的語意對比 (Semantic Distinction)
g10-s2-u7.tip2.formula: He has two sons who are doctors (可能有其他兒子) vs. He has two sons, who are doctors (總共只有兩個兒子)
g10-s2-u7.tip2.body: 無逗號為限定修飾 (眾多中的一部分)；有逗號為補充說明 (等於全部)。
g10-s2-u7.tip2.example: Paris, which is the capital of France, attracts millions of tourists annually.

g10-s2-u8.tip1.title: 複合關係代名詞 what 的本質 (The Anatomy of 'What')
g10-s2-u8.tip1.formula: what + 缺主詞或受詞之不完整子句 = the thing(s) which / that
g10-s2-u8.tip1.body: what 本身兼具「先行詞 + 關係代名詞」雙重身分，因此前面絕對不可再有先行詞！
g10-s2-u8.tip1.example: What surprised everyone was her calm demeanor under pressure.

g10-s2-u8.x1.prompt: The ancient manuscript, ___ was discovered in an underground cave near the Dead Sea, contains Hebrew scriptures.
g10-s2-u8.x1.hint: 先判斷先行詞是人還是物，再注意空格前的逗號。
g10-s2-u8.x1.why: 【考點解構】先行詞 The ancient manuscript 為無生命事物，且前後以逗號隔開為「非限定關係子句」；考場必背鐵律：that 絕不可用於逗號之後的非限定子句，故只能選 which。

wrong.that: 「that」的意思是「那;那個」；這裡要的是「which」（哪一個,哪一些;這個,這些）。

g10-s2-u8.tip2.title: 準關係代名詞 as 的常規句型 (Quasi-Relative 'As')
g10-s2-u8.tip2.formula: as is known to all / as was expected / such ... as ...
g10-s2-u8.tip2.body: as 可作準關係代名詞引導子句，常置於句首代指後面的整句話，意為「正如...所...」。
g10-s2-u8.tip2.example: As is widely acknowledged, physical exercise enhances mental health.

g10-s2-u8.x2.prompt: ___ is often the case with first drafts, Leo's essay needed several revisions.
g10-s2-u8.x2.hint: 想一想：哪個關係詞可以放在句首，代替後面整個主要子句的內容？
g10-s2-u8.x2.why: 準關係代名詞 as 引導的子句可放在句首，代替後面整個主要子句（As is often the case… 正如常見的情況）。which 引導的非限定子句不能放在句首；What 子句會變成名詞子句，接不上後面的句子；That 也不能這樣用。

wrong.Which: 「Which」的意思是「哪一個,哪一些;這個,這些」；這裡要的是「As」（跟...一樣地,同樣地;如同;例如）。
wrong.What: 「What」的意思是「什麼;多麼,何等」；這裡要的是「As」（跟...一樣地,同樣地;如同;例如）。
wrong.That: 「That」的意思是「那;那個」；這裡要的是「As」（跟...一樣地,同樣地;如同;例如）。

g10-s2-u8.q1.prompt: ________ is needed right now is a comprehensive contingency plan to deal with supply chain disruptions.
g10-s2-u8.q1.hint: 空格引導整個主詞子句，且空格後缺主詞 is needed。 空格前無先行詞，等於 The thing which is needed。
g10-s2-u8.q1.why: 複合關係代名詞 What 引導名詞子句作主詞，自身代表 the thing which。

wrong.That: That 引導名詞子句時自己不當主詞，但空格後 is needed 缺主詞。
wrong.Which: Which 帶有選擇範圍，這裡需要「所需要的東西」，語意不合。
wrong.It: It 是代名詞，不能引導名詞子句當主詞。

g10-s2-u8.trap1.answer: I cannot understand the reason that made her quit.
options: I cannot understand the reason that made her quit.
I cannot understand the reason what made her quit.
g10-s2-u8.trap1.why: 先行詞 the reason 在子句中當 made 的主詞，要用關係代名詞 that 或 which；what 本身已含先行詞，不可再接在 the reason 後面。注意 why 是關係副詞，不能當主詞（比較：the reason why she quit）。

wrong.I cannot understand the reason what made: what 已含先行詞，不能接在 the reason 後面，要用 that 或 which。

g10-s2-u8.r1.passage: What distinguishes secure cryptographic protocols from traditional authentication is mathematical verifiability. Whoever attempts to manipulate ledger entries encounters immediate cryptographic rejection. As has been proven in multiple security audits, decentralized consensus guarantees integrity without reliance on a single central entity.
g10-s2-u8.r1.passageTitle: The Architecture of Trust in Online Transactions (網路交易的信任架構)
g10-s2-u8.r1.prompt: What is the subject of the main clause in the first sentence?
g10-s2-u8.r1.answer: The noun clause 'What distinguishes secure cryptographic protocols from traditional authentication'.
options: The noun clause 'What distinguishes secure cryptographic protocols from traditional authentication'.
Because 'that' cannot follow a preposition directly in a relative clause.
Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.
g10-s2-u8.r1.hint: 複合關係詞拆解：將 what 還原為 the thing which，檢驗主受格完整性。
g10-s2-u8.r1.why: 文章依據：The noun clause 'What distinguishes secure cryptographic protocols from traditional authentication'.

wrong.Because 'that' cannot follow a prepositi: 這是講 that 不能接介系詞的文法理由，沒有回答主要子句主詞是什麼。
wrong.Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a: 這是 be accustomed to 的文法解釋，與第一句的主詞無關。

d.diag-0861.prompt: ___ achieves the highest cumulative score in the competition will win the scholarship.
d.diag-0861.hint: 題意：凡是在這場競賽中獲得最高累計總分的人，都將贏得全額獎學金。
d.diag-0861.why: Whoever 相當於 anyone who，在名詞子句中擔任主詞，意為「凡是…的人」。 名詞子句當主詞選 Whoever。
d.diag-0861.topic: 複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever

wrong.Whomever: Whomever 是受格，但空格在子句中當 achieves 的主詞，要用主格。
wrong.Whichever: Whichever 指有限範圍中的某一個，這裡指凡是得高分的人。
wrong.Whatever: Whatever 指事物，而這裡指的是得獎的人。

d.diag-0862.prompt: You can order ___ dessert you prefer from the gourmet banquet menu.
d.diag-0862.hint: 這題考：複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever
d.diag-0862.why: whichever + 名詞 (dessert) 表「在有限範圍中無論哪一個」。 有限範圍挑選用 whichever。
d.diag-0862.topic: 複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever

wrong.whoever: whoever 指人，但後面的 dessert 是甜點，不是人。
wrong.however: however 是「無論如何」的副詞，不能直接修飾名詞 dessert。
wrong.wherever: wherever 是「無論哪裡」，不能修飾 dessert。

d.diag-0863.prompt: ___ challenges you might encounter during the journey, stay resolute and optimistic.
d.diag-0863.hint: 這題考：複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever
d.diag-0863.why: Whatever + 名詞 (challenges) 引導讓步狀語子句，意為「無論何種…」。 讓步狀語名詞前加 Whatever。
d.diag-0863.topic: 複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever

wrong.Whoever: Whoever 指人，但後面的 challenges 是挑戰，不是人。
wrong.Whichever: Whichever 表示在有限範圍中選擇，但旅途中的挑戰沒有固定範圍。
wrong.Whenever: Whenever 是「無論何時」，不能直接修飾名詞 challenges。

d.diag-0864.prompt: The coach promised to award the MVP trophy to ___ played with the greatest dedication.
d.diag-0864.hint: 題意：教練承諾將最有價值球員獎盃頒發給任何帶著最高奉獻精神打球的人。
d.diag-0864.why: 介系詞 to 後之名詞子句缺主詞，子句主詞必須使用主格 whoever（非 whomever）！ 子句作主詞必須選主格 whoever。
d.diag-0864.topic: 複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever

wrong.whomever: 子句缺的是 played 的主詞，要用主格 whoever，不是受格。
wrong.whichever: whichever 指有範圍的選擇，這裡指凡是最努力的人，且不接名詞。
wrong.whatever: whatever 指事物，但這裡是指打球的人。

d.diag-0865.prompt: Please choose ___ seat is available in the auditorium.
d.diag-0865.hint: 這題考：複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever
d.diag-0865.why: whichever seat（在有限座位中無論哪一個）。 有限範圍選 whichever。
d.diag-0865.topic: 複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever

wrong.whoever: whoever 指人，但 seat 是座位。
wrong.however: however 是副詞「無論如何」，不能修飾名詞 seat。
wrong.wherever: wherever 是「無論哪裡」，不能直接放在 seat 前面當限定詞。

d.diag-0866.prompt: ___ happens in the financial markets tomorrow, we will adhere to our long-term plan.
d.diag-0866.hint: 這題考：複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever
d.diag-0866.why: Whatever 作子句主詞（無論發生何事）。 無論何事作主詞選 Whatever。
d.diag-0866.topic: 複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever

wrong.Whoever: Whoever 指人，但 happens 的主詞是發生的事情。
wrong.Whichever: Whichever 需要有限的選擇範圍，這裡是不特定的任何事。
wrong.However: However 是「無論如何」的副詞，不能當 happens 的主詞。

d.diag-0867.prompt: You can invite ___ you feel would genuinely benefit from this leadership workshop.
d.diag-0867.hint: 題意：你可以邀請任何一位你認為真正能從這場領導力工作坊中獲益的人。
d.diag-0867.why: 空格引導的名詞子句整體當 invite 的受詞，但空格在子句中是 would benefit 的主詞（you feel 是插入語：you feel [某人] would benefit），所以用主格 whoever；whomever 在此是常見的過度修正。正確答案為「whoever」。
d.diag-0867.topic: 複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever

wrong.whatever: whatever 指事物，但 would benefit 的主詞是人。
wrong.whomever: 空格是 would benefit 的主詞，要用主格 whoever，不是受格。
wrong.whichever: whichever 表有限範圍的選擇，這裡指任何覺得會受益的人。

d.diag-0868.prompt: Take ___ textbook you need to prepare for tomorrow's biology examination.
d.diag-0868.hint: 這題考：複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever
d.diag-0868.why: whichever textbook 表在指定課本中無論哪一本。 書籍挑選選 whichever。
d.diag-0868.topic: 複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever

wrong.whoever: whoever 指人，但後面的 textbook 是課本。
wrong.wherever: wherever 是「無論哪裡」，不能修飾 textbook。
wrong.however: however 是副詞，不能直接修飾名詞 textbook。

d.diag-0869.prompt: ___ breaks the sacred archaeological relics will face severe legal penalties.
d.diag-0869.hint: 題意：凡是破壞神聖考古文物的人都將面臨嚴厲的法律制裁處罰。
d.diag-0869.why: 子句當主詞選 Whoever。 凡是何人選 Whoever。
d.diag-0869.topic: 複合關係代名詞 whoever, whatever, whichever

wrong.Whomever: Whomever 是受格，但空格是 breaks 的主詞，要用主格。
wrong.Whatever: Whatever 指事物，但打破文物的是人。
wrong.Whichever: Whichever 表有限範圍的選擇，這裡是指任何做這件事的人。

g10-s2-u9.tip1.title: 篇章轉折副詞標點規範 (Punctuation of Transition Adverbs)
g10-s2-u9.tip1.formula: Sentence 1; therefore, Sentence 2.  OR  Sentence 1. In addition, Sentence 2.
g10-s2-u9.tip1.body: 連接副詞不能只靠單一逗號連接兩個獨立子句。位於句首時常加逗號，也可放在句中：I therefore agree.，標點依位置判斷。
g10-s2-u9.tip1.example: The cost of lithium batteries has plummeted; consequently, electric vehicle adoption has surged.

g10-s2-u9.x1.prompt: Choose the correctly punctuated pair of independent clauses.
g10-s2-u9.x1.hint: Sentence 1; therefore, Sentence 2. OR Sentence 1. In addition, Sentence 2.
g10-s2-u9.x1.why: however 是連接副詞；此處用分號分隔獨立子句，再以逗號接續。

however 是連接副詞，只用逗號會把兩個獨立句錯接在一起。
兩個獨立子句之間沒有任何標點，however 前後也缺逗號。

g10-s2-u9.tip2.title: 四大核心邏輯語義家族 (Four Major Logical Families)
g10-s2-u9.tip2.formula: Contrast (轉折) | Additive (遞進) | Causal (因果) | Exemplification (舉例)
g10-s2-u9.tip2.body: 1. 轉折: nevertheless, however, conversely 2. 遞進: furthermore, moreover, additionally 3. 因果: thus, hence, accordingly 4. 舉例: specifically, notably.
g10-s2-u9.tip2.example: Renewable energy produces minimal emissions. Furthermore, operational costs decline over time.

g10-s2-u9.x2.prompt: Solar panels produce almost no emissions. ___, their operating costs fall over time.
g10-s2-u9.x2.hint: Contrast (轉折) | Additive (遞進) | Causal (因果) | Exemplification (舉例)
g10-s2-u9.x2.why: 第二句再加上一項優點，屬於遞進關係，用 Furthermore。However 表轉折、For example 表舉例、Otherwise 表「否則」。

g10-s2-u9.q1.prompt: The archaeological expedition faced unrelenting blizzards and equipment malfunctions; ________, the researchers persisted until the tomb was unearthed.
g10-s2-u9.q1.hint: 前句提到遭遇暴風雪與設備故障 (困難障礙)。 後句提到研究人員堅持不懈直到墓穴出土 (反向轉折)。
g10-s2-u9.q1.why: 前後語意為困難與堅毅的反向轉折，應用 nevertheless (然而/儘管如此)。

Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.

g10-s2-u9.r1.why: 文章依據：To introduce the adverse result of algorithmic feeds prioritizing sensationalism.

k.paragraph-cohesion.tip.title: 段落連貫：連接語與代名詞要接得上
k.paragraph-cohesion.tip.formula: 精準辨析篇章語意邏輯（轉折、因果、順序），正確區分連接詞與連接副詞之標點結構，並追蹤代名詞之明確指涉。
k.paragraph-cohesion.tip.body: 篇章連貫（Cohesion 與 Coherence）是大考與學術寫作的靈魂。連接詞與轉折語表達句與句之間的邏輯關係。關鍵語法分界：從屬/對等連接詞（如 but, although, because, so）能直接連接兩個子句；而連接副詞（Conjunctive Adverbs，如 however, therefore, moreover, nevertheless, furthermore）本質上是副詞，不能只用一個逗號連接兩句（此為典型 Comma Splice 錯誤），必須使用「句號 + However,」或…
k.paragraph-cohesion.tip.example: The app is convenient. However, it requires an internet connection. / The road was flooded. Therefore, the school bus took another route.

k.paragraph-cohesion.1.prompt: The course was demanding. ___, Mei enjoyed the challenge.
k.paragraph-cohesion.1.why: 課程困難卻享受挑戰，形成對比。therefore 需要因果；for example 需要後句作前句例子，這裡都不合。
k.paragraph-cohesion.1.hint: 先判斷前後兩句的邏輯關係：是轉折、因果，還是舉例？

wrong.Therefore: 「Therefore」的意思是「因此、所以 (因果副詞)」；這裡要的是「However」（然而、不過 (轉折副詞)）。

k.paragraph-cohesion.2.prompt: In “Students revised their essays. This process took two hours,” what does “This process” refer to?
k.paragraph-cohesion.2.why: process 表過程，接前句修改文章的動作，不是學生本人。原文也沒有提到搭公車。
k.paragraph-cohesion.2.hint: This process 的 process（過程）指的是前一句的人，還是前一句的動作？

d.diag-0911.prompt: Traditional fossil fuels emit vast amounts of greenhouse gases. ___, renewable solar energy is clean and virtually limitless.
d.diag-0911.hint: 題意：傳統化石燃料排放大量溫室氣體。相反地，再生太陽能乾淨且幾乎無窮無盡。
d.diag-0911.why: 前後句對立對比，使用 Conversely（相反地、反之）。 相反對比選 Conversely。

d.diag-0912.prompt: The medical procedure carried severe potential risks; ___, the patient chose to undergo it.
d.diag-0912.hint: 題意：這項醫療手術伴隨著嚴重的潛在風險；儘管如此，病患依然選擇接受該手術。
d.diag-0912.why: 風險極高與依然選擇接受形成讓步轉折，使用 nevertheless（儘管如此）。 讓步轉折選 nevertheless。

d.diag-0913.prompt: The factory violated environmental regulations repeatedly. ___, it was slapped with hefty government fines.
d.diag-0913.hint: 題意：該工廠屢次違反環保法規。因此，它遭到了政府巨額罰款的重罰處分。
d.diag-0913.why: 違規（因）導致罰款（果），副詞使用 Consequently（因此、結果）。 因果後果選 Consequently。

d.diag-0914.prompt: Regular cardiovascular exercise enhances physical stamina. ___, it reduces risks of chronic ailments.
d.diag-0914.hint: 題意：規律心血管運動增強身體耐力。此外，它還能降低罹患慢性病痛的風險。
d.diag-0914.why: 進一步正面補充益處，使用 Furthermore（此外）。 正面遞進選 Furthermore。

d.diag-0915.prompt: Critics claimed the new smartphone model would flop. ___, it became the bestselling device of the year.
d.diag-0915.hint: 題意：評論家曾宣稱這款新手機型號將會慘遭滑鐵盧。正相反，它成了年度最暢銷的智慧設備。
d.diag-0915.why: 否定前面的負面預測並引出完全相反的正面事實，使用 On the contrary（恰恰相反）。 完全相反的事實選 On the contrary。

wrong.Therefore: Therefore 表因果，但前句預測失敗、後句卻暢銷，是相反關係。
wrong.In addition: In addition 表補充，但後句是推翻前句預測，不是補充。
wrong.Similarly: Similarly 表相似，但前後兩句的結果正好相反。

d.diag-0916.prompt: Urban rents have escalated beyond affordability. ___, many young professionals are relocating to suburban districts.
d.diag-0916.hint: 題意：城市房租已飛漲到難以負擔的地步。結果，許多年輕職場專業人士正遷往郊區城鎮。
d.diag-0916.why: 房租高（因）引發遷徙（果），選 As a result（結果）。 因果結果選 As a result。

d.diag-0917.prompt: The scientist's breakthrough theory was initially dismissed by peers. ___, it was later acknowledged as a stroke of genius.
d.diag-0917.why: 前後由被質疑轉折到獲承認，選 However。 轉折對比選 However。

wrong.Therefore: 「Therefore」的意思是「因此、所以 (因果副詞)」；這裡要的是「However」（然而、不過 (轉折副詞)）。
wrong.Moreover: 「Moreover」的意思是「並且,加之,此外」；這裡要的是「However」（然而、不過 (轉折副詞)）。

d.diag-0918.prompt: She did not spend the windfall on frivolous luxuries. ___, she invested it in a college scholarship fund.
d.diag-0918.why: 前句否定 did not spend，後句引出替代善舉，使用 Instead（取而代之）。 替代方案選 Instead。

wrong.Therefore: 「Therefore」的意思是「因此、所以 (因果副詞)」；這裡要的是「Instead」（反而,卻）。
wrong.Moreover: 「Moreover」的意思是「並且,加之,此外」；這裡要的是「Instead」（反而,卻）。

d.diag-0919.prompt: Global supply chains suffered severe disruptions during the conflict. ___, food prices surged worldwide.
d.diag-0919.why: 因果相應承接使用 Accordingly（相應地、因此）。 相應因果選 Accordingly。

wrong.However: 「However」的意思是「然而、不過 (轉折副詞)」；這裡要的是「Accordingly」（照著;相應地;因此）。

g10-s2-u11.tip1.title: 對過去事件的推測矩陣 (Modal Deduction about Past Events)
g10-s2-u11.tip1.formula: must have p.p. (必定做過) | can't/couldn't have p.p. (不可能做過) | may/might have p.p. (可能做過)
g10-s2-u11.tip1.body: 情態助動詞後加 have + p.p. 表示對「過去事實」的推測或判斷。
g10-s2-u11.tip1.example: The streets are soaking wet; it must have rained cats and dogs last night.

g10-s2-u11.x1.prompt: Her coat is gone and her desk is empty. Which expresses a deduction about the past?
g10-s2-u11.x1.hint: must have p.p. (必定做過) | can't/couldn't have p.p. (不可能做過) | may/might have p.p. (可能做過)
g10-s2-u11.x1.why: must have + 過去分詞表示對過去的強烈推測；不是直接確認的事實。

g10-s2-u11.tip2.title: should have p.p. 的遺憾與責備 (Counterfactual Regret)
g10-s2-u11.tip2.formula: should have p.p. (本來應該做卻沒做) vs. shouldn't have p.p. (本來不該做卻做了)
g10-s2-u11.tip2.body: 表達與過去事實相反的批評或懊悔，為假設語氣的縮影。

g10-s2-u11.x2.prompt: I forgot my umbrella and got wet. “I should have brought it” expresses ___.

k.culture-etiquette-hs.tip.title: 跨文化比較與國際禮儀：說明差異與原因
k.culture-etiquette-hs.tip.formula: 以英語介紹並比較國內外文化習俗，探討差異的成因，在國際場合應用基本禮儀。
k.culture-etiquette-hs.tip.body: 比較文化時，從「描述 → 比較 → 解釋原因 → 反思」四層次說明：描述具體行為（In Japan, people often remove their shoes indoors.）、比較（Similarly / In contrast）、解釋原因（This may be because… / This reflects…）、反思自身（This made me realize…）。避免以單一經驗概括整個國家（stereotype），改用 many、often、some。國際禮儀包含守時、致謝信、名片雙手遞接、用…
k.culture-etiquette-hs.tip.example: In contrast to Taiwan, tipping is expected in many U.S. restaurants. / This may be because servers’ wages depend partly on tips.

options: In some cultures, arriving a little late to a party is considered polite.
k.culture-etiquette-hs.1.answer: In some cultures, arriving a little late to a party is considered polite.
k.culture-etiquette-hs.1.why: 用 some cultures 並描述具體情境，避免以偏概全。
k.culture-etiquette-hs.1.hint: 比較文化時，先描述具體行為，再比較、解釋原因並反思，避免以偏概全。

Every 把所有亞洲人說成同一種喜好，是刻板印象。

語序混亂，to 後面不能接 the report 再接 me。

quality.original.g10-s1-u1.7.prompt: Which sentence correctly follows consider + object + complement?
options: We consider insufficient the evidence is.
We consider the evidence to insufficient.
quality.original.g10-s1-u1.7.why: evidence 後的形容詞 insufficient 是受詞補語。

wrong.We consider insufficient the evidence is: 多了 is 變成兩個動詞，語序也不通順。
wrong.We consider the evidence to insufficient: to 後面要接原形動詞，不能直接接形容詞 insufficient。

quality.original.g10-s1-u1.8.prompt: In “The results became clearer,” clearer describes ___.
quality.original.g10-s1-u1.8.why: became 是連綴動詞，clearer 是主詞補語。

quality.original.g10-s1-u1.9.prompt: Which sentence requires an object to complete this use of the verb?
quality.original.g10-s1-u1.9.why: discuss 此用法直接接討論內容 findings。

laughed 是不及物動詞，不需要受詞就完整。
arrived 是不及物動詞，不需要受詞。

quality.original.g10-s1-u1.10.prompt: Which sentence contains a complete independent clause?
quality.original.g10-s1-u1.10.why: 第一句有主詞 method 與主要動詞 works；其餘不完整。

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.12zovi4.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.12zovi4.answer: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.12zovi4.why: context /ˈkɑnˌtɛkst/：上下文；語境；背景；情境；脈絡。搭配：in this context (在此脈絡下)。例：Without the context, the single quoted sentence seemed much harsher than intended.（缺少上下文，那句被單獨引用的話看起來比原意嚴厲許多。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1hv0y78.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1hv0y78.why: evidence /ˈɛvɪdəns/：顯示,表明。搭配：evidence a change (顯示出變化)。例：His smile evidences how much he enjoyed the school trip.（他的笑容顯示出他有多喜歡這趟校外旅行。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1fn17tg.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1fn17tg.why: inference /ˈɪnfɚəns/：必然推論、暗含推知。搭配：draw an inference (做出推論)。例：One reasonable inference from the sales dip is that competitors launched a cheaper alternative.（從銷售下滑可以得到的一項合理推論是，競爭對手推出了更便宜的替代品。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.s9804r.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.s9804r.why: interpretation /ˈɪntɛrpretaʃən/：解釋;闡明。搭配：an important interpretation (解釋;闡明)。例：A sudden change in interpretation forced the organizers to revise their original plan.（解釋的突然變化，迫使主辦單位修正原本的計畫。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.y9j7ze.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.y9j7ze.why: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/：未言明的前提假設 (若否定之，結論必崩潰)。搭配：underlying assumption (未言明的根本假設)。例：The marketing argument relies on the implicit assumption that consumer disposable income will not fall.（該行銷論證仰賴於一個潛在未言明的前提假設：消費者的可支配所得不會下滑。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1ym94b9.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1ym94b9.why: perspective /pɚˈspek.tɪv/：視角、觀點、遠景。搭配：from a global perspective (從全球視角來看)。例：Studying abroad allows students to examine domestic issues from an objective perspective.（出國留學能讓學生從客觀的視角來審視國內議題。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.p3aa9c.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.p3aa9c.why: implication /ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃən/：暗示、實質影響。搭配：a clear implication (明確的暗示)。例：The study's implication is that raising wages may actually reduce long-term turnover costs.（這項研究的含意是，調高薪資實際上可能降低長期的人員流動成本。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1g7bo6b.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1g7bo6b.why: analysis /ˈanælysis/：分析。搭配：an important analysis (分析)。例：A careful analysis of the data showed a clear pattern.（仔細分析這些數據後，發現了明顯的規律。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.u8brz3.why: evaluation /ɪˌvæljuˈeɪʃən/：績效評估；評價；考評報告。搭配：performance evaluation (績效評估)。例：The annual evaluation showed that the team met all its sales targets.（年度評估顯示，團隊達成了所有銷售目標。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.29d0lq.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.29d0lq.why: conclusion /ˈcɑːncluʒən/：結論、推論總結。搭配：an important conclusion (結論)。例：Tom came to the conclusion that no matter what he did, Mary wouldn't like it.（湯姆得出無論他做什麼，瑪麗都不會喜歡的結論。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1suceuu.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1suceuu.why: argument /ˈærgumənt/：爭論。搭配：an important argument (爭論)。例：After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.（經過長久的爭論，我終於說服了她去露營。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1ghamb3.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1ghamb3.why: claim /kleɪm/：聲稱。搭配：claim to be (聲稱是)。例：He claims that he saw a shooting star last night.（他聲稱自己昨晚看到了流星。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.gfr9pk.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.gfr9pk.why: support /ˈsʌppɑːrt/：支持。搭配：support effectively / carefully (support 方式)。例：My parents always support my dream of becoming a doctor.（我的父母一直支持我當醫生的夢想。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.919oe.why: challenge /ˈtʃælleŋe/：對...提出異議。搭配：challenge effectively / carefully (challenge 方式)。例：Smart investors challenge risk by spreading their funds across multiple sectors.（聰明的投資人透過將資金分散到不同產業來對...提出異議風險。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1quqafc.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1quqafc.why: relevant /ˈrelevænt/：有關的;切題的。搭配：a relevant condition / outcome (有關的;切題的狀態)。例：That would be relevant.（那可能有關係。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.auyojk.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.auyojk.why: significant /ˈsɪgnificænt/：有意義的。搭配：a significant condition / outcome (有意義的狀態)。例：Despite the pressure, the pilot remained significant and landed the plane safely.（儘管面臨壓力，機師依然保持有意義，並安全降落飛機。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.kw3w1e.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.kw3w1e.why: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/：精準；精確；嚴謹；準確的。搭配：precise measurements (精確的測量)。例：She gave precise directions, so we found the warehouse without any trouble.（她給了精準的路線說明，所以我們毫不費力就找到了倉庫。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.j8y43f.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.j8y43f.answer: 條理連貫的、前後一致的
options: 條理連貫的、前後一致的
上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.j8y43f.why: coherent /koʊˈhɪr.ənt/：條理連貫的、前後一致的。搭配：a coherent narrative / argument (條理清晰的敘事/論述)。例：The essay lacks a coherent structure, jumping erratically between unrelated historical epochs.（該散文缺乏連貫條理的結構，在不相關的歷史時代之間跳躍不定。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.9he0e9.why: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/：前後一致的、相符的。搭配：consistent with the data (與數據相符)。例：The new data are consistent with the theory that customers prefer subscriptions over one-time purchases.（新數據與顧客偏好訂閱制而非單次購買的理論相符。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.bix4rw.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.bix4rw.answer: 貌似合理的、合乎情理的
options: 貌似合理的、合乎情理的
上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.bix4rw.why: plausible /ˈplɑː.zə.bəl/：貌似合理的、合乎情理的。搭配：a plausible explanation (看似合理的解釋)。例：Paleontologists offered a plausible explanation for the sudden extinction of the apex predators.（古生物學家對頂級掠食者的驟然滅絕提出了貌似合理的解釋。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.t3v1op.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.t3v1op.why: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/：明確清楚的；直截了當的。搭配：explicit instructions (明確的指示)。例：The manual gives explicit instructions, leaving no room for guessing.（說明書給出明確的指示，沒有任何猜測的餘地。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1oe5ppi.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1oe5ppi.why: implicit /ˈɪmplicit/：不言明的;含蓄的。搭配：a implicit condition / outcome (不言明的;含蓄的狀態)。例：The laboratory follows implicit safety rules when handling chemical samples.（實驗室在處理化學樣本時遵循不言明的安全規範。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1iy0x9k.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.1iy0x9k.why: alternative /ɔlˈtɝnətɪv/：替代假說、備選方案。搭配：consider an alternative (考慮替代方案)。例：Before approving the merger, the board asked staff to present at least one realistic alternative.（批准合併前，董事會要求員工至少提出一個可行的替代方案。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.mxwp5t.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.mxwp5t.why: limitation /ˌlɪməˈteɪʃən/：極限,限度。搭配：know your limitations (認清自己的極限)。例：Every camera has its limitations, so it cannot take clear photos in total darkness.（每台相機都有極限，所以在全黑中拍不出清楚的照片。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.iq49dd.why: valid /ˈvalid/：有根據的;有效的。搭配：a valid condition / outcome (有根據的;有效的狀態)。例：It's valid until March thirty-first, nineteen-ninety-seven.（有效期到1997年3月31日為止。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.oy5dk3.why: reliable /ˈreliəbəl/：可信賴的;可靠的;確實的。搭配：a reliable condition / outcome (可信賴的;可靠的;確實的狀態)。例：The weather forecast is not reliable at all.（天氣預報一點也不可靠。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.lcqihj.why: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡjuəs/：具多重解釋的、含混不清的。搭配：an ambiguous answer (含混的答案)。例：The sign's wording was ambiguous, so tourists could not tell whether to turn left or right.（路標的措辭含混不清，所以遊客分不出該左轉還是右轉。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.c3neew.why: subtle /ˈsʌbtle/：微妙的;難捉摸的。搭配：a subtle condition / outcome (微妙的;難捉摸的狀態)。例：The documentary presents subtle evidence of how glaciers are retreating.（這部紀錄片呈現了冰川正在退縮的微妙證據。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.diewiu.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u1.diewiu.why: indicate /ˈɪndɪˌkeɪt/：指出。搭配：indicate the way (指出方向)。例：The arrow on the sign indicates the way to the library.（標誌上的箭頭指出前往圖書館的路。）

quality.dialogue.1uwnr5w.prompt: 聽懂這句情境英語，再選擇意思。
quality.dialogue.1uwnr5w.audio: The client expects a price cut to increase both market share and profit.
quality.dialogue.1uwnr5w.answer: 客戶預期降價能同時提高市占率和利潤。
options: 客戶預期降價能同時提高市占率和利潤。
要讓利潤增加，需要哪些條件成立？
新增銷售必須彌補較低利潤率和增加的成本。
接受預測前，也應詢問競爭對手可能如何回應。
quality.dialogue.1uwnr5w.why: The client expects a price cut to increase both market share and profit.｜客戶預期降價能同時提高市占率和利潤。。區分需求、收入與淨利；增加銷量不保證淨利上升，需補充條件與證據。

contentSource.title: GMAT 批判推理與商業長文（情境實戰會話）

wrong.要讓利潤增加，需要哪些條件成立？: 你選的「要讓利潤增加，需要哪些條件成立？」，英文是「What would have to be true for profit to rise?」；題目的英文是「The client expects a price cut to increase both market share and profit.」，意思是「客戶預期降價能同時提高市占率和利潤。」。
wrong.新增銷售必須彌補較低利潤率和增加的成本。: 你選的「新增銷售必須彌補較低利潤率和增加的成本。」，英文是「Extra sales would need to make up for the lower margin and any added costs.」；題目的英文是「The client expects a price cut to increase both market share and profit.」，意思是「客戶預期降價能同時提高市占率和利潤。」。
wrong.接受預測前，也應詢問競爭對手可能如何回應。: 你選的「接受預測前，也應詢問競爭對手可能如何回應。」，英文是「We should also ask how competitors might respond before accepting that forecast.」；題目的英文是「The client expects a price cut to increase both market share and profit.」，意思是「客戶預期降價能同時提高市占率和利潤。」。

quality.dialogue.k8bdq3.prompt: 聽懂這句情境英語，再選擇意思。
quality.dialogue.k8bdq3.audio: What would have to be true for profit to rise?
quality.dialogue.k8bdq3.answer: 要讓利潤增加，需要哪些條件成立？

客戶預期降價能同時提高市占率和利潤。
新增銷售必須彌補較低利潤率和增加的成本。
接受預測前，也應詢問競爭對手可能如何回應。
quality.dialogue.k8bdq3.why: What would have to be true for profit to rise?｜要讓利潤增加，需要哪些條件成立？。區分需求、收入與淨利；增加銷量不保證淨利上升，需補充條件與證據。

contentSource.title: GMAT 批判推理與商業長文（情境實戰會話）

wrong.新增銷售必須彌補較低利潤率和增加的成本。: 你選的「新增銷售必須彌補較低利潤率和增加的成本。」，英文是「Extra sales would need to make up for the lower margin and any added costs.」；題目的英文是「What would have to be true for profit to rise?」，意思是「要讓利潤增加，需要哪些條件成立？」。
wrong.接受預測前，也應詢問競爭對手可能如何回應。: 你選的「接受預測前，也應詢問競爭對手可能如何回應。」，英文是「We should also ask how competitors might respond before accepting that forecast.」；題目的英文是「What would have to be true for profit to rise?」，意思是「要讓利潤增加，需要哪些條件成立？」。

wrong.換電動公車也能減少塞車嗎？: 你選的「換電動公車也能減少塞車嗎？」，英文是「Would switching to electric buses also reduce traffic congestion?」；題目的英文是「Should our city help pay for electric buses?」，意思是「我們的城市應該補助電動公車嗎？」。
wrong.光換車不會，還要有可靠的服務，讓人願意不開車。: 你選的「光換車不會，還要有可靠的服務，讓人願意不開車。」，英文是「Not by itself. We'd need reliable service that encourages people to leave their cars at home.」；題目的英文是「Should our city help pay for electric buses?」，意思是「我們的城市應該補助電動公車嗎？」。

quality.dialogue.hxoll.prompt: 聽懂這句情境英語，再選擇意思。
quality.dialogue.hxoll.audio: I think so. They could reduce exhaust emissions along busy routes.
quality.dialogue.hxoll.answer: 我認為應該，它們能減少繁忙路線的廢氣排放。
options: 我認為應該，它們能減少繁忙路線的廢氣排放。
我們的城市應該補助電動公車嗎？
換電動公車也能減少塞車嗎？
光換車不會，還要有可靠的服務，讓人願意不開車。
quality.dialogue.hxoll.why: I think so. They could reduce exhaust emissions along busy routes.｜我認為應該，它們能減少繁忙路線的廢氣排放。。原創學術討論練習；電動化減排與減少壅塞是不同主張，需各自有證據。

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.12zovi4.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.12zovi4.answer: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.12zovi4.why: context /ˈkɑnˌtɛkst/：上下文；語境；背景；情境；脈絡。搭配：in this context (在此脈絡下)。例：Without the context, the single quoted sentence seemed much harsher than intended.（缺少上下文，那句被單獨引用的話看起來比原意嚴厲許多。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1hv0y78.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1hv0y78.why: evidence /ˈɛvɪdəns/：顯示,表明。搭配：evidence a change (顯示出變化)。例：His smile evidences how much he enjoyed the school trip.（他的笑容顯示出他有多喜歡這趟校外旅行。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1fn17tg.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1fn17tg.why: inference /ˈɪnfɚəns/：必然推論、暗含推知。搭配：draw an inference (做出推論)。例：One reasonable inference from the sales dip is that competitors launched a cheaper alternative.（從銷售下滑可以得到的一項合理推論是，競爭對手推出了更便宜的替代品。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.s9804r.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.s9804r.why: interpretation /ˈɪntɛrpretaʃən/：解釋;闡明。搭配：an important interpretation (解釋;闡明)。例：A sudden change in interpretation forced the organizers to revise their original plan.（解釋的突然變化，迫使主辦單位修正原本的計畫。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.y9j7ze.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.y9j7ze.why: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/：未言明的前提假設 (若否定之，結論必崩潰)。搭配：underlying assumption (未言明的根本假設)。例：The marketing argument relies on the implicit assumption that consumer disposable income will not fall.（該行銷論證仰賴於一個潛在未言明的前提假設：消費者的可支配所得不會下滑。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1ym94b9.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1ym94b9.why: perspective /pɚˈspek.tɪv/：視角、觀點、遠景。搭配：from a global perspective (從全球視角來看)。例：Studying abroad allows students to examine domestic issues from an objective perspective.（出國留學能讓學生從客觀的視角來審視國內議題。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.p3aa9c.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.p3aa9c.why: implication /ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃən/：暗示、實質影響。搭配：a clear implication (明確的暗示)。例：The study's implication is that raising wages may actually reduce long-term turnover costs.（這項研究的含意是，調高薪資實際上可能降低長期的人員流動成本。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1g7bo6b.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1g7bo6b.why: analysis /ˈanælysis/：分析。搭配：an important analysis (分析)。例：A careful analysis of the data showed a clear pattern.（仔細分析這些數據後，發現了明顯的規律。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.u8brz3.why: evaluation /ɪˌvæljuˈeɪʃən/：績效評估；評價；考評報告。搭配：performance evaluation (績效評估)。例：The annual evaluation showed that the team met all its sales targets.（年度評估顯示，團隊達成了所有銷售目標。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.29d0lq.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.29d0lq.why: conclusion /ˈcɑːncluʒən/：結論、推論總結。搭配：an important conclusion (結論)。例：Tom came to the conclusion that no matter what he did, Mary wouldn't like it.（湯姆得出無論他做什麼，瑪麗都不會喜歡的結論。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1suceuu.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1suceuu.why: argument /ˈærgumənt/：爭論。搭配：an important argument (爭論)。例：After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.（經過長久的爭論，我終於說服了她去露營。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1ghamb3.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1ghamb3.why: claim /kleɪm/：聲稱。搭配：claim to be (聲稱是)。例：He claims that he saw a shooting star last night.（他聲稱自己昨晚看到了流星。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.gfr9pk.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.gfr9pk.why: support /ˈsʌppɑːrt/：支持。搭配：support effectively / carefully (support 方式)。例：My parents always support my dream of becoming a doctor.（我的父母一直支持我當醫生的夢想。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.919oe.why: challenge /ˈtʃælleŋe/：對...提出異議。搭配：challenge effectively / carefully (challenge 方式)。例：Smart investors challenge risk by spreading their funds across multiple sectors.（聰明的投資人透過將資金分散到不同產業來對...提出異議風險。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1quqafc.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1quqafc.why: relevant /ˈrelevænt/：有關的;切題的。搭配：a relevant condition / outcome (有關的;切題的狀態)。例：That would be relevant.（那可能有關係。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.auyojk.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.auyojk.why: significant /ˈsɪgnificænt/：有意義的。搭配：a significant condition / outcome (有意義的狀態)。例：Despite the pressure, the pilot remained significant and landed the plane safely.（儘管面臨壓力，機師依然保持有意義，並安全降落飛機。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.kw3w1e.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.kw3w1e.why: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/：精準；精確；嚴謹；準確的。搭配：precise measurements (精確的測量)。例：She gave precise directions, so we found the warehouse without any trouble.（她給了精準的路線說明，所以我們毫不費力就找到了倉庫。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.j8y43f.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.j8y43f.answer: 條理連貫的、前後一致的
options: 條理連貫的、前後一致的
上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.j8y43f.why: coherent /koʊˈhɪr.ənt/：條理連貫的、前後一致的。搭配：a coherent narrative / argument (條理清晰的敘事/論述)。例：The essay lacks a coherent structure, jumping erratically between unrelated historical epochs.（該散文缺乏連貫條理的結構，在不相關的歷史時代之間跳躍不定。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.9he0e9.why: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/：前後一致的、相符的。搭配：consistent with the data (與數據相符)。例：The new data are consistent with the theory that customers prefer subscriptions over one-time purchases.（新數據與顧客偏好訂閱制而非單次購買的理論相符。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.bix4rw.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.bix4rw.answer: 貌似合理的、合乎情理的
options: 貌似合理的、合乎情理的
上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.bix4rw.why: plausible /ˈplɑː.zə.bəl/：貌似合理的、合乎情理的。搭配：a plausible explanation (看似合理的解釋)。例：Paleontologists offered a plausible explanation for the sudden extinction of the apex predators.（古生物學家對頂級掠食者的驟然滅絕提出了貌似合理的解釋。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.t3v1op.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.t3v1op.why: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/：明確清楚的；直截了當的。搭配：explicit instructions (明確的指示)。例：The manual gives explicit instructions, leaving no room for guessing.（說明書給出明確的指示，沒有任何猜測的餘地。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1oe5ppi.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1oe5ppi.why: implicit /ˈɪmplicit/：不言明的;含蓄的。搭配：a implicit condition / outcome (不言明的;含蓄的狀態)。例：The laboratory follows implicit safety rules when handling chemical samples.（實驗室在處理化學樣本時遵循不言明的安全規範。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1iy0x9k.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.1iy0x9k.why: alternative /ɔlˈtɝnətɪv/：替代假說、備選方案。搭配：consider an alternative (考慮替代方案)。例：Before approving the merger, the board asked staff to present at least one realistic alternative.（批准合併前，董事會要求員工至少提出一個可行的替代方案。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.mxwp5t.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.mxwp5t.why: limitation /ˌlɪməˈteɪʃən/：極限,限度。搭配：know your limitations (認清自己的極限)。例：Every camera has its limitations, so it cannot take clear photos in total darkness.（每台相機都有極限，所以在全黑中拍不出清楚的照片。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.iq49dd.why: valid /ˈvalid/：有根據的;有效的。搭配：a valid condition / outcome (有根據的;有效的狀態)。例：It's valid until March thirty-first, nineteen-ninety-seven.（有效期到1997年3月31日為止。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.oy5dk3.why: reliable /ˈreliəbəl/：可信賴的;可靠的;確實的。搭配：a reliable condition / outcome (可信賴的;可靠的;確實的狀態)。例：The weather forecast is not reliable at all.（天氣預報一點也不可靠。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.lcqihj.why: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡjuəs/：具多重解釋的、含混不清的。搭配：an ambiguous answer (含混的答案)。例：The sign's wording was ambiguous, so tourists could not tell whether to turn left or right.（路標的措辭含混不清，所以遊客分不出該左轉還是右轉。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.c3neew.why: subtle /ˈsʌbtle/：微妙的;難捉摸的。搭配：a subtle condition / outcome (微妙的;難捉摸的狀態)。例：The documentary presents subtle evidence of how glaciers are retreating.（這部紀錄片呈現了冰川正在退縮的微妙證據。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.diewiu.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u2.diewiu.why: indicate /ˈɪndɪˌkeɪt/：指出。搭配：indicate the way (指出方向)。例：The arrow on the sign indicates the way to the library.（標誌上的箭頭指出前往圖書館的路。）

quality.dialogue.4kuhxb.prompt: 聽懂這句情境英語，再選擇意思。
quality.dialogue.4kuhxb.audio: Good morning! I am heading to the Nangang Exhibition Center. I have a meeting at nine.
quality.dialogue.4kuhxb.answer: 早安！我要去南港展覽館，我九點鐘有一場會議。
options: 早安！我要去南港展覽館，我九點鐘有一場會議。
現在平面主要道路塞得水洩不通。我改走高架快速道路好嗎？
好，麻煩了。走那條路大概要多久？
大約二十分鐘。我們到的時候要在哪裡讓您下車呢？
quality.dialogue.4kuhxb.why: Good morning! I am heading to the Nangang Exhibition Center. I have a meeting at nine.｜早安！我要去南港展覽館，我九點鐘有一場會議。。口語動向：be heading to + 地點（正要前往某地），比 go to 更自然。

quality.dialogue.1o88imz.answer: 現在平面主要道路塞得水洩不通。我改走高架快速道路好嗎？
options: 現在平面主要道路塞得水洩不通。我改走高架快速道路好嗎？

好，麻煩了。走那條路大概要多久？
大約二十分鐘。我們到的時候要在哪裡讓您下車呢？
