d.diag-0771.prompt: If I ___ you, I would consult a licensed physician before taking that medication.
d.diag-0771.hint: 題意：如果我是你，我在服用那項藥物之前一定會先諮詢執業醫師。
d.diag-0771.why: 與現在事實相反的假設語氣，if 子句 be 動詞在正式文法上一律使用 were！ 與現在相反假設 be動詞用 were。
d.diag-0771.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.was: 與現在事實相反的假設，正式文法 be 動詞用 were，不用 was。
wrong.am: am 是現在直述語氣，不是假設語氣。
wrong.would be: would 不能放在 if 子句中，if 子句用 were。

d.diag-0772.prompt: If Leo ___ sufficient financial capital, he would launch his own tech startup.
d.diag-0772.hint: 題意：如果 Leo 擁有充足的資金資本，他就會開創自己的科技新創公司。
d.diag-0772.why: 與現在事實相反，if 子句動詞使用過去式 had，主要子句使用 would + 原形動詞。 與現在相反動詞過去式 had。
d.diag-0772.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.has: has 是現在式，與現在相反的假設要用過去式 had。
wrong.would have: would 不放在 if 子句中，且 would have 是主要子句的形式。
wrong.had had: had had 是過去完成式，指與過去相反，但本句主要子句是 would launch。

d.diag-0773.prompt: Emily would travel around the globe if she ___ from severe flight anxiety.
d.diag-0773.hint: 題意：如果 Emily 不是飽受嚴重飛行焦慮之苦，她就會環遊世界。
d.diag-0773.why: 主要子句為 would travel，條件子句需用過去否定式 did not suffer。 與現在相反否定選 did not suffer。
d.diag-0773.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.does not suffer: 現在式不是假設語氣，與現在相反的 if 子句要用過去式。
wrong.would not suffer: would 不放在 if 子句中。
wrong.had not suffered: had not suffered 指與過去相反，但主要子句是 would travel（現在假設）。

d.diag-0774.prompt: If we ___ wings like migratory birds, we could soar freely across the ocean.
d.diag-0774.hint: 題意：如果我們像候鳥一樣擁有翅膀，我們就能自由翱翔飛越海洋。
d.diag-0774.why: 與人類現在事實相反，使用過去式 had，主要子句搭配 could soar。 與現在相反條件選 had。
d.diag-0774.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.have: have 是現在式，與現在相反的假設要用過去式 had。
wrong.would have: would 不放在 if 子句中。
wrong.had had: had had 指與過去事實相反，但主要子句是 could soar，是現在假設。

d.diag-0775.prompt: What ___ you do if you suddenly won a ten-million-dollar lottery jackpot?
d.diag-0775.hint: 題意：如果你突然中了千萬美元的樂透頭彩，你將會怎麼做？
d.diag-0775.why: 條件子句為過去式 won（純假設），主要子句疑問句需搭配 would you do。 假設語氣主要子句選 would。
d.diag-0775.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.will: will 是真實未來，但 won 是過去式假設，主要子句要用 would。
wrong.did: did you do 不能搭配假設的 if 子句，語氣不合。
wrong.do: do 是現在式，與過去式假設 won 的語氣不一致。

d.diag-0776.prompt: If the historic library ___ open on weekends, more community members would visit.
d.diag-0776.hint: 題意：如果這座歷史圖書館週末開放的話，會有更多社區民眾前來參觀。
d.diag-0776.why: 與現狀相反假設，be 動詞使用 were。 與現在相反選 were。
d.diag-0776.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.is: is 是現在直述語氣，不是與現狀相反的假設。
wrong.was being: was being 是過去進行式，不是假設語氣。
wrong.would be: would 不能放在 if 子句中，要用 were。

d.diag-0777.prompt: Tony could easily solve this intricate riddle if he ___ more attentive in class.
d.diag-0777.hint: 題意：如果 Tony 上課更專注一點的話，他就能輕易解開這道複雜的謎題。
d.diag-0777.why: 條件子句與現在事實相反，be 動詞使用 were。 與現在相反選 were。
d.diag-0777.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.is: is 是現在直述語氣，無法表達與現在相反的假設。
wrong.was being: was being 是過去進行式，不合假設語氣。
wrong.has been: has been 是現在完成式，與主要子句 could solve 的假設不合。

d.diag-0778.prompt: If my brother ___ French, he would definitely apply for the Paris internship.
d.diag-0778.hint: 題意：如果我哥哥會法語的話，他絕對會申請巴黎的實習職位。
d.diag-0778.why: 現在不會法語的純假設，if 子句使用過去式 spoke。 與現在相反選 spoke。
d.diag-0778.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.speaks: speaks 是現在式，與現在相反的假設要用過去式 spoke。
wrong.would speak: would 不能放在 if 子句中。
wrong.had spoken: had spoken 指與過去相反，但主要子句是 would apply（現在假設）。

d.diag-0779.prompt: I ___ that expensive sports car even if I had millions of dollars.
d.diag-0779.hint: 題意：即便我擁有數百萬美元，我也不會購買那輛昂貴的跑車。
d.diag-0779.why: 主要子句假設結果使用 would not buy。 假設語氣主要子句選 would not buy。
d.diag-0779.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.will not buy: will 是真實未來，但 even if I had 是假設，要用 would。
wrong.did not buy: did not buy 是過去事實，不是假設結果。
wrong.had not bought: had not bought 是過去完成式，不能當假設的主要子句動詞。

d.diag-0780.prompt: If the earth ___ stop rotating, life as we know it would instantly collapse.
d.diag-0780.hint: 題意：假若地球未來萬一停止轉動，我們所知的生命將瞬間崩潰。
d.diag-0780.why: 表示對未來極不可能實現的假設，if 子句使用 were to + V！ 未來不可能實現假設選 were to。
d.diag-0780.topic: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣 (If S were/V-ed, S would V)

wrong.will: 「will」的意思是「將;願,要;能;願意」，放進這裡不符合句意或用法；正確答案是「were to」。

d.diag-0781.prompt: If Tony ___ the warning signs, he would not have fallen into the treacherous ditch.
d.diag-0781.hint: 題意：如果 Tony 當時注意到了警告標誌，他就不會掉進危險的溝渠裡了。
d.diag-0781.why: 與過去事實相反的假設：if 子句使用過去完成式 (had + p.p.)，主要子句使用 would have + p.p.！ 與過去事實相反條件子句選 had noticed。
d.diag-0781.topic: 與過去事實相反之假設語氣 (If S had p.p., S would have p.p.)

wrong.noticed: 過去式 noticed 是與現在相反，但主要子句是 would not have fallen。
wrong.would notice: would 不放在 if 子句中。
wrong.would have noticed: would have noticed 是主要子句形式，不能放在 if 子句。

d.diag-0782.prompt: We ___ the flight if the taxi driver had not taken that clever shortcut.
d.diag-0782.hint: 題意：如果計程車司機當時沒有走那條巧妙的捷徑，我們早就錯過那班飛機了。
d.diag-0782.why: 與過去相反主要子句：would have + p.p. (missed)。 與過去相反主要子句選 would have missed。
d.diag-0782.topic: 與過去事實相反之假設語氣 (If S had p.p., S would have p.p.)

wrong.missed: 單純過去式 missed 不是假設結果，要用 would have missed。
wrong.would miss: would miss 是現在假設，但 had not taken 是過去相反，要用 would have。
wrong.had missed: had missed 是過去完成式，不是與過去相反的結果句形式。

d.diag-0783.prompt: If the emergency brake ___ immediately, the catastrophe would have been unavoidable.
d.diag-0783.hint: 題意：如果緊急剎車當時沒有立刻發揮作用，那場災難原本是無可避免的。
d.diag-0783.why: 條件子句與過去事實相反，使用 had not functioned。 過去假設條件選 had not functioned。
d.diag-0783.topic: 與過去事實相反之假設語氣 (If S had p.p., S would have p.p.)

wrong.did not function: 過去式指與現在相反，但主要子句是 would have been（過去相反）。
wrong.would not function: would 不放在 if 子句中。
wrong.has not functioned: 現在完成式不是假設語氣，與 would have been 不搭配。

d.diag-0784.prompt: Emily would have secured first place if she ___ that minor calculation error.
d.diag-0784.hint: 題意：如果 Emily 當時沒有犯下那個微小的計算錯誤，她原本早就奪得第一名了。
d.diag-0784.why: if 條件子句與過去相反，使用 had not made。 與過去相反選 had not made。
d.diag-0784.topic: 與過去事實相反之假設語氣 (If S had p.p., S would have p.p.)

quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.12zovi4.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.12zovi4.answer: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.12zovi4.why: context /ˈkɑnˌtɛkst/：上下文；語境；背景；情境；脈絡。搭配：in this context (在此脈絡下)。例：Without the context, the single quoted sentence seemed much harsher than intended.（缺少上下文，那句被單獨引用的話看起來比原意嚴厲許多。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.1hv0y78.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.1hv0y78.why: evidence /ˈɛvɪdəns/：顯示,表明。搭配：evidence a change (顯示出變化)。例：His smile evidences how much he enjoyed the school trip.（他的笑容顯示出他有多喜歡這趟校外旅行。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.1fn17tg.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.1fn17tg.why: inference /ˈɪnfɚəns/：必然推論、暗含推知。搭配：draw an inference (做出推論)。例：One reasonable inference from the sales dip is that competitors launched a cheaper alternative.（從銷售下滑可以得到的一項合理推論是，競爭對手推出了更便宜的替代品。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.s9804r.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.s9804r.why: interpretation /ˈɪntɛrpretaʃən/：解釋;闡明。搭配：an important interpretation (解釋;闡明)。例：A sudden change in interpretation forced the organizers to revise their original plan.（解釋的突然變化，迫使主辦單位修正原本的計畫。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.y9j7ze.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.y9j7ze.why: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/：未言明的前提假設 (若否定之，結論必崩潰)。搭配：underlying assumption (未言明的根本假設)。例：The marketing argument relies on the implicit assumption that consumer disposable income will not fall.（該行銷論證仰賴於一個潛在未言明的前提假設：消費者的可支配所得不會下滑。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.1ym94b9.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.1ym94b9.why: perspective /pɚˈspek.tɪv/：視角、觀點、遠景。搭配：from a global perspective (從全球視角來看)。例：Studying abroad allows students to examine domestic issues from an objective perspective.（出國留學能讓學生從客觀的視角來審視國內議題。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.p3aa9c.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.p3aa9c.why: implication /ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃən/：暗示、實質影響。搭配：a clear implication (明確的暗示)。例：The study's implication is that raising wages may actually reduce long-term turnover costs.（這項研究的含意是，調高薪資實際上可能降低長期的人員流動成本。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.1g7bo6b.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
options: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.1g7bo6b.why: analysis /ˈanælysis/：分析。搭配：an important analysis (分析)。例：A careful analysis of the data showed a clear pattern.（仔細分析這些數據後，發現了明顯的規律。）

quality.lex.g10-s1-u3.u8brz3.why: evaluation /ɪˌvæljuˈeɪʃən/：績效評估；評價；考評報告。搭配：performance evaluation (績效評估)。例：The annual evaluation showed that the team met all its sales targets.（年度評估顯示，團隊達成了所有銷售目標。）

wrong.有什麼證據支持這個說法？: 你選的「有什麼證據支持這個說法？」，英文是「What evidence supports that claim?」；題目的英文是「Sales rose after the park opened, but a subway station opened nearby, too.」，意思是「公園開放後銷售增加，但附近也開了捷運站。」。
wrong.那在接受主張前，我們得考慮那個替代解釋。: 你選的「那在接受主張前，我們得考慮那個替代解釋。」，英文是「Then we need to consider that alternative explanation before accepting the claim.」；題目的英文是「Sales rose after the park opened, but a subway station opened nearby, too.」，意思是「公園開放後銷售增加，但附近也開了捷運站。」。

g12-s1-u4.q1.prompt: Which transitional phrase best introduces a profound personal counter-argument in an essay?
g12-s1-u4.q1.answer: Be that as it may, a deeper examination reveals...
options: And also, I want to say that...
Be that as it may, a deeper examination reveals...
Because of this, so I think...
First of all, I am very happy because...
g12-s1-u4.q1.hint: 論說文的讓步轉折要先承認前述觀點，再提出更深入的反駁，並使用正式語域；And also、so 這類口語連接方式不適合。
g12-s1-u4.q1.why: 'Be that as it may, a deeper examination reveals...' 為高階英文論述極具典雅說服力之過渡句。

And also 口語又重複，不是正式文章中引出深刻反駁的過渡語。
Because of 與 so 同時出現重複，且是表因果，不是反駁。
First of all 用來列第一點，不是反駁，語氣也太個人。

g12-s1-u4.r1.passage: In contemporary society, constant digital notifications tether individuals to an incessant stream of online chatter. While smartphones provide instantaneous connection, they paradoxically deprive us of tranquil introspection. It is during deliberate solitude that authentic creativity flourishes, allowing our minds to consolidate memories and synthesize original thoughts. Had I not learned to unplug from virtual networks regularly, my intellectual autonomy would have been subsumed by algorithmic conformity.
g12-s1-u4.r1.passageTitle: Model Essay: Embracing Solitude in a Hyper-Connected World (範文鑑賞：在高度連結的世界擁抱孤獨)
g12-s1-u4.r1.prompt: Identify the inverted conditional in the model essay.
g12-s1-u4.r1.answer: 'Had I not learned to unplug from virtual networks regularly, my intellectual autonomy would have been subsumed...'
options: 'Had I not learned to unplug from virtual networks regularly, my intellectual autonomy would have been subsumed...'
The argument that users bear individual responsibility for curating diverse perspectives.
g12-s1-u4.r1.hint: 評分規準對照：分析範文中高階轉折詞、句型多樣性與論點深化技巧。
g12-s1-u4.r1.why: 文章依據：'Had I not learned to unplug from virtual networks regularly, my intellectual autonomy would have been subsumed...'

這是別題的答案內容，文章中沒有倒裝條件句出現在這裡。
wrong.The argument that users bear individual: 這是另一篇文章中對手的論點，不是這篇的倒裝條件句。

g12-s1-u4.x1.prompt: A writing prompt explicitly requests TWO paragraphs. What should guide the structure?
g12-s1-u4.x1.answer: Follow the two-paragraph task and develop each purpose.
options: Follow the two-paragraph task and develop each purpose.
g12-s1-u4.x1.hint: Paragraph 1: Situation Description / Objective Prompt Analysis (約 60-70 字) | Paragraph 2: In-Depth Personal Reflection …
g12-s1-u4.x1.why: 以該題提示為準；不要硬套固定三段或四段模板。

題目明確要求兩段，固定寫四段不符合要求。
題目要求兩段並分別發展，一句話無法完成。

g12-s1-u4.x2.prompt: ___ by the spectacular aurora borealis in northern Norway, the tourists stood in stunned silence for hours.
g12-s1-u4.x2.hint: 1. 分詞構句 (Feeling..., she...) | 2. 假設語氣倒裝 (Had I known...) | 3. 分裂強調句 (It is ... that ...)
g12-s1-u4.x2.why: 【考點解構】分詞修飾主要子句主詞 the tourists；遊客是被極光「深深吸引 (be fascinated by)」，省略連接詞與主詞後，被動語態保留過去分詞 Fascinated。

wrong.Fascinating: Fascinating 是主動、令人著迷的意思，但遊客是被極光吸引。
wrong.To fascinate: 不定詞 To fascinate 表目的，不能表示被極光吸引的原因。
wrong.Having fascinated: Having fascinated 是主動完成式，變成遊客去吸引極光，意思錯誤。

g12-s2-u10.q1.prompt: What logical fallacy occurs when someone distorts an opponent's argument to make it easier to attack?
g12-s2-u10.q1.hint: 這種謬誤攻擊的不是對方真正的論點，而是被故意扭曲、誇大後的替身。
g12-s2-u10.q1.why: 曲解或誇大他人論點以便攻擊，稱為「稻草人謬誤 (Straw Man Fallacy)」。

g12-s2-u10.r1.passage: Confirmation bias—the human cognitive inclination to embrace information confirming pre-existing beliefs while ignoring disconfirming data—has been dramatically amplified by algorithmic content feeds. Critics argue that users bear individual responsibility for curating diverse perspectives. Admittedly, personal media literacy is indispensable. However, when recommendation engines are mathematically optimized for engagement over veracity, individual willpower alone cannot withstand systemic behavioral engineering.
g12-s2-u10.r1.passageTitle: The Dangers of Confirmation Bias in Algorithmic Societies (演算法社會中確認偏誤的危機)
g12-s2-u10.r1.prompt: What counter-argument does the author acknowledge before presenting their rebuttal?
g12-s2-u10.r1.answer: The argument that users bear individual responsibility for curating diverse perspectives.
options: The argument that users bear individual responsibility for curating diverse perspectives.
g12-s2-u10.r1.hint: 邏輯論證結構解構：標註文章中的前題、論點、反方意見與作者最終反駁。
g12-s2-u10.r1.why: 文章依據：The argument that users bear individual responsibility for curating diverse perspectives.

這與演算法推薦與確認偏誤的文章無關，作者承認的是使用者責任。
這是個數字，文章裡沒有任何百分比，也不是作者承認的反方論點。

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1o21o6d.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1o21o6d.why: data /ˈdata/：資料,數據。搭配：an important data (資料,數據)。例：As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.（資料表明年輕人抽菸的現象沒有減少。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.kp9xpb.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.kp9xpb.why: table：桌子、餐桌。例句：The book is on the table.

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.olm6a3.why: chart /ˈtʃært/：繪製...的圖表;詳細計劃。搭配：chart effectively / carefully (chart 方式)。例：Our class charted the temperature every day for a month.（我們班連續一個月每天把氣溫畫成圖表。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1fglh6v.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1fglh6v.why: graph /ˈgraf/：用圖表表示。搭配：graph effectively / carefully (graph 方式)。例：The workshop taught participants how to graph their time more effectively.（這場工作坊教導與會者如何更有效地用圖表表示自己的時間。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.r3eyh5.why: figure /ˈfɪɡjɚ/：估計;描繪。搭配：figure the cost (估算費用)。例：Mom figured the trip would cost about two hundred dollars.（媽媽估計這趟旅行大約要花兩百美元。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.15zjyr9.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.15zjyr9.why: percentage /pɚˈsɛntɪdʒ/：百分率,百分比。搭配：a high percentage (高百分比)。例：A large percentage of the class chose pizza for the party.（班上很大比例的同學選了披薩當派對餐點。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1csrk2f.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1csrk2f.why: proportion /prəˈpɔrʃən/：使成比例;使平衡;分攤。搭配：proportion the rooms (使房間比例協調)。例：The architect proportioned the rooms so that each had enough light.（建築師按比例設計各個房間，使每間都有足夠的光線。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1cf67vr.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1cf67vr.why: rate /ˈrate/：對...評價。搭配：rate effectively / carefully (rate 方式)。例：Customers can rate each restaurant from one to five stars on the app.（顧客可以在這個應用程式上給每家餐廳打一到五顆星的評價。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1hkj344.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1hkj344.why: ratio /ˈratio/：比率;比例。搭配：an important ratio (比率;比例)。例：Clear knowledge of ratio helps students connect textbook theory with daily life.（對比率的清楚認識，能幫助學生將課本理論與日常生活連結起來。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1wofnt5.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1wofnt5.why: amount /əˈmaʊnt/：合計,共計。搭配：amount to ten dollars (共計十元)。例：The bill amounts to fifty dollars.（帳單總共是五十美元。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.7q2940.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.7q2940.why: number /ˈnʌmbɚ/：編號,總數達到,共計。搭配：number effectively / carefully (number 方式)。例：When opinions differ, it helps to number the shared goals first.（當意見出現分歧時，先編號彼此的共同目標會很有幫助。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1c3cot.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1c3cot.why: total /ˈtotal/：總的。搭配：a total condition / outcome (總的狀態)。例：The total cost of the snacks was 250 dollars.（這些零食的總價是兩百五十元。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.6hfodk.why: average /ˈaverage/：平均的。搭配：a average condition / outcome (平均的狀態)。例：The average age of the students in this class is fourteen.（這班學生的平均年齡是十四歲。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1xlrl5e.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1xlrl5e.why: range /ˈraŋe/：排列。搭配：range effectively / carefully (range 方式)。例：The books are ranged neatly on the shelves by size.（書本依照大小整齊地排列在架子上。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1ytatd9.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1ytatd9.why: increase /ˈɪncriːse/：增加。搭配：increase effectively / carefully (increase 方式)。例：There was a steady increase in population.（人口穩定地增加。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1nin5mp.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1nin5mp.why: decrease /dɪˈkris/：減少。搭配：decrease in number (數量減少)。例：The number of visitors will decrease in winter because the weather is cold.（冬天天氣冷，遊客人數會減少。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1rl44io.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1rl44io.why: rise：上升、升起。例句：The sun rises in the east.

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1wwprhc.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1wwprhc.why: fall：落下、跌倒。例句：Be careful not to fall.

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1gbzt06.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1gbzt06.why: stable /ˈstəbəl/：穩定的,牢固的。搭配：a stable condition / outcome (穩定的,牢固的狀態)。例：The judge issued a stable ruling after reviewing all the witness statements.（法官在審閱所有證人陳述後，做出了穩定的裁決。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.97j1ww.why: trend /ˈtrɛnd/：趨勢,傾向;時尚。搭配：an important trend (趨勢,傾向;時尚)。例：Wearing oversized jackets is the latest fashion trend among teenagers.（穿寬大的外套是青少年之間最新的時尚潮流。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1et639u.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1et639u.why: peak /ˈpiːk/：使尖起;達到高峰;聳起。搭配：peak effectively / carefully (peak 方式)。例：Courts must peak the law fairly regardless of social status.（無論社會地位高低，法院都必須公正地尖起法律。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.14xdpfb.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.14xdpfb.why: minimum /ˈmɪnəməm/：最小的,最少的。搭配：minimum wage (最低工資)。例：You need a minimum of ten points to pass the quiz.（你至少要拿十分才能通過小考。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.pigby9.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.pigby9.why: maximum /ˈmæksəməm/：最大限度的。搭配：maximum speed (最高速度)。例：The elevator has a maximum load of eight people.（這部電梯最多可載八個人。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1bzobb8.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1bzobb8.why: comparison /kəmˈpærəsən/：比較,對照。搭配：in comparison with (與…相比)。例：A comparison of the two phones showed that the cheaper one lasts longer.（兩支手機的比較顯示，比較便宜的那支更耐用。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.elcu97.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.elcu97.answer: 經銷通路物流配銷分配
options: 經銷通路物流配銷分配
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.elcu97.why: distribution /ˌdɪstrəˈbjuʃən/：經銷通路；物流配銷；分配。搭配：distribution network (配銷網絡)。例：Efficient distribution keeps fresh milk cold from the farm to the supermarket.（有效率的配銷讓新鮮牛奶從牧場到超市都保持冰涼。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.15v6o4n.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.15v6o4n.why: sample /ˈsæmple/：取...的樣品;抽樣檢查。搭配：sample effectively / carefully (sample 方式)。例：You can sample the cheese before you buy it.（你可以在買之前先試吃這塊起司。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.108fh4h.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.108fh4h.why: scale /skeɪl/：尺度;等級;級別。搭配：on a scale of (以…的等級)。例：On a scale of one to ten, I would give the movie an eight.（以一到十的等級來說，我會給這部電影八分。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1skg6pz.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.1skg6pz.why: unit /ˈunit/：單位;單元;組件。搭配：an important unit (單位;單元;組件)。例：We will finish Unit 3 of our English book this week.（我們這週會上完英文課本的第三單元。）

quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.16un03b.prompt: 選出本單元延伸字詞的意思。
quality.lex.g10-s2-u10.16un03b.why: estimate /ˈɛstimate/：估算估價估價單；估計。搭配：an important estimate (估算估價估價單)。例：How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?（你估計做那件事需要花費你多少時間呢？）

contentSource.title: 學術長篇閱讀與雙文比較（情境實戰會話）

wrong.它指出新員工可能少了同事的非正式指導。: 你選的「它指出新員工可能少了同事的非正式指導。」，英文是「It points out that new employees may miss informal advice from coworkers.」；題目的英文是「Text A says remote work improves productivity. How does Text B respond?」，意思是「A 文說遠距工作提升生產力，B 文怎麼回應？」。
wrong.所以 B 文完全反對遠距工作嗎？: 你選的「所以 B 文完全反對遠距工作嗎？」，英文是「So is Text B rejecting remote work entirely?」；題目的英文是「Text A says remote work improves productivity. How does Text B respond?」，意思是「A 文說遠距工作提升生產力，B 文怎麼回應？」。
wrong.不是，它質疑短期產出能否說明全貌。: 你選的「不是，它質疑短期產出能否說明全貌。」，英文是「No. It's questioning whether short-term output tells the whole story.」；題目的英文是「Text A says remote work improves productivity. How does Text B respond?」，意思是「A 文說遠距工作提升生產力，B 文怎麼回應？」。

wrong.confiscate: confiscate 是沒收，政府為綠色建設撥款不是沒收。

wrong.conservation: conservation 是保育，不是燃燒化石燃料造成的結果。
wrong.sequestration: sequestration 是封存碳，會減少而不是增加二氧化碳。

g11-s2-u10.q1.prompt: According to the passage, what does the circular economy aim to 'decouple'?
g11-s2-u10.q1.passage: For over a century, global industrial capitalism has operated under a linear model characterized by extracting, manufacturing, and discarding. This 'take-make-waste' approach has generated catastrophic plastic accumulation in oceans and unprecedented resource depletion. In contrast, the circular economy conceives production loops where waste becomes input. By designing durable modular products and recovering critical minerals from obsolete electronics, nations can decouple economic prosperity from environmental destruction.
g11-s2-u10.q1.passageTitle: The Global Circular Economy: Reimagining Resource Lifecycles (全球循環經濟：重塑資源生命週期)
g11-s2-u10.q1.hint: 定位文章最後一句中的 decouple（使脫鉤），看它把哪兩件事分開。
g11-s2-u10.q1.why: 文章末句明確指出脫鉤經濟繁榮與環境破壞。

g11-s2-u10.r1.prompt: What is the core philosophy of a circular economy according to the passage?
g11-s2-u10.r1.answer: To conceive production loops where waste becomes input, decoupling economic growth from environmental harm.

g11-s2-u10.r1.why: 文章依據：To conceive production loops where waste becomes input, decoupling economic growth from environmental harm.
